jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

**A Few Things About Us**

Welcome to Diverzify+! We are the largest and most respected commercial flooring installation service company in the industry, with 60+ locations across the U.S. and a team of nearly 2,300. Our innovative vision and partnerships with top companies set us apart. Working with us means joining a fun and hardworking team. We offer competitive pay and total rewards (Medical, Dental, Vision, Telemedical, Mental Health, Prescriptions, HSA/FSA, Life and AD&D, and 401k Company Match). Come join us and be a part of something amazing!

**Job Summary**

At Diverzify+ and our Family of Brands, our Project Coordinators work closely with Project Managers to plan and execute flooring projects from start to finish. Responsibilities include creating action plans, scheduling resources, managing budgets and timelines, coordinating tasks, handling risk management, and maintaining project documentation. They ensure projects meet quality standards, stay on budget, and deliver customer satisfaction through effective communication and time management.

Requirements:

**Job Responsibilities**

* Manage paperwork flow for Account Managers' or Executives' projects, verifying contracts, POs, and change orders for accuracy
* Build customer relations through timely document return and create routing sheets to track paperwork
* Communicate with suppliers about product availability and place/track material orders
* Make freight arrangements for cost-effective product shipments
* Perform timely follow-ups on shipments and track multiple deliveries
* Distribute bi-monthly Salesperson billing summary sheets for customer billing
* Maintain project documentation in job folders and the computer system
* Prepare monthly AIA-type billing and ensure job folders support payment verifications and final invoicing
* Review change orders, verify billing documents, and submit for client approval
* Complete accurate billing and follow up with clients for payment verification
* Prepare necessary project close-outs at project completion.

**Qualifications**

* Proven work experience in a Construction Administration role.
* Experience in project management, from conception to delivery.
* An ability to prepare and interpret flowcharts, schedules, and step-by-step action plans.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Microsoft Planner.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* BSc in Business Administration or related field
* Experience as a Project Coordinator role or similar within the construction industry.
* Familiarity with risk management and quality assurance control
* Hands-on experience with project management tools
* PMP / PRINCE2 certification

*We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.*

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:

· Make sure that clients’ needs are met as projects evolve

· Monitor project progress and handle any issues that arise

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview:

As a ***Project Coordinator*** at Schuff Steel, You will assist in managing the flow of technical information between the Schuff Steel Project Management team, customers, and subcontractors and vendors, while developing critical relationships with internal and external clients, through verbal and written communication. They collaborate with other departments to ensure all aspects of each project are executed smoothly. Schuff PC’s have worked on some of the most amazing building structures in North America. Please consider joining our dynamic Project Management Team.

Responsibilities:

**Job Overview**

* Reviews design drawings for accuracy and completeness, and coordinates resolution of discrepancies and/or missing information with customers, design team, other trades, detailing, shop, & field as may be necessary.
* Coordinates project sequencing and basic detailing job setup, including advance bills and shop and erection drawings.
* Provides technical instructions and guidance to steel detailers in preparing shop drawings per project requirements and standards.
* Monitors project schedules regarding submittals, approvals, and shop fabrication releases. Identify and communicate possible delays or problems to project management team.
* Organize detailing RFI process through formal RFI to customer and informal RFI’s with the engineer, architect, and general contractor. Facilitates and fulfills other documentation efforts and duties and as may be required.
* Distribute and route drawings. Partner with Document Control to avoid delays and maintain logs.
* Act as a liaison between shop, field, and detailers to resolve fabrication and erection difficulties.
* Maintains daily communication with Project Manager, Sr. Project Manager or Vice President on progress of areas of responsibility.
* Assists the Project Management Team in achieving successful project results.
* Coordinates the detailing efforts of various common subcontractors.
* Serve as a direct link between Detailers, Project Managers, and other production departments, and customer, other contractors, and Design Team as may be required.

Qualifications:

**Education/Training**

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Associates degree or training from an approved and accredited technical school in engineering or detailing/drafting is highly preferred.
* A Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in CM, Structural/Civil Engineering, or other technical area may substitute for required experience.

**Work Experience**

* At least five (5) years related experience in the coordination of structural steel projects. Detailing experience highly preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Ability to read and interpret shop and design drawings.
* General understanding and knowledge of basic drafting skills
* 3D modeling software/Tekla practices, fabrication and erection standards, standard technical terminology, common structural steel practices, and drafting room procedures.

**Software & Technology**

  

* MS Windows 10, MS Office 365; Office Word, Excel, and Outlook; Contract Manager, Primavera Scheduling, Fabtrol and Tekla system. Bluebeam applications.

**Work Environment**

* The position may require frequent air/road travel as needed and required. A clean driving record will be required due to required road travel.
* A current and valid driver’s license and proof of acceptable insurance is required.
* This position is generally indoors in a climate-controlled office. However, frequent visitations to the outdoor plant facilities and project sites may be required.
* Reasonable accommodations will be made upon request for those who have disabilities that qualify under the American with Disabilities Act.

At Schuff Steel, we believe our employees are our greatest asset. Our team environment is based on respect, effective communications, and accountability. We believe employees should have great working conditions along with opportunities to grow and develop. We proudly promote a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone has a chance to be successful. Schuff Steel is an Equal Opportunity Employer with an Affirmative Action Plan. We value Diversity.

Rated by ENR as a leading builder in America, please consider joining our elite organization today. Apply directly. No agencies #LI-KF1

Pay Range: The anticipated compensation for this position is USD $65,000.00/Yr. - USD $90,000.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.

jobs.title: Youth Alumni Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Program: Workforce Development

Department: Youth Services

Reports to: Sr. Program Manager, Workforce Development

Status: 100%, Full-Time, Non Exempt

Probation: 90 days

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision; also including Life Insurance, Long-Term Disability, Employee Assistance Program, and a 403(b) Retirement Plan

Center’s Mission:

Building a world where LGBT people thrive as healthy, equal, and complete members of society.

**DEPARTMENT SUMMARY:**The Youth Center serves youth up to the age of 24 who are currently at-risk of or experiencing homelessness. The Youth Center offers services in an LGBTQ+ safe and affirming environment and serves as an entry point to assist youth making the transition from homelessness to housing. Our services include meals, clothing, support groups, a charter high school, GED and college prep program, employment preparation, training and placement program, case management, counseling, a crisis shelter and a transitional living program (TLP). Our community-based programs include services for youth at home, in school, or in systems of care.

**JOB SUMMARY**: As an integral part of the Workforce Development team, the Youth Alumni Program Coordinator coordinates retention strategies that transition participants from vocational training into active alumni engagement. This role collaborates across departments to support youth aging out of programs, provides supportive services and mentorship coordination, and strengthens long-term participant stability. This position tracks alumni outcomes, manages data and reporting requirements, oversees alumni communications and events, and ensures continuous program evaluation and improvement to meet organizational and funder goals.

**ESSENTIAL****FUNCTIONS**

**% of Role**

25

**Program Coordination & Strategy**

* Coordinate and implement a comprehensive retention strategy that transitions vocational training participants into alumni status
* Lead a peer mentorship program connecting alumni with current youth participants
* Evaluate alumni program initiatives and events, identifying successes, challenges, and recommendations for improvement
* Support strategic development of the aged-out system to ensure continuity of services for youth transitioning from all department programs

35

**Participant Engagement & Support Services**

* Partner with Workforce Development team coordinate and strengthen participant engagement and retention
* Provide appointment-based supportive services to alumni and connect them to appropriate community resources
* Partner with the Mentoring Navigator to ensure all alumni are matched with mentors
* Build rapport with participants to promote progression from program enrollment to active alumni involvement

10

**Data Management & Reporting**

* Maintain and coordinate alumni database systems in partnership with Youth Academy and IT teams to ensure accurate tracking of youth transitions
* Track and report on alumni outcomes related to housing, employment, health, and overall stability
* Prepare monthly and funder-required reports detailing alumni program performance
* Collect, analyze, and distribute program evaluations to leadership, staff, and the Steering Committee

10

**Event Coordination**

* Plan and coordinate alumni events, collaborating with task force as necessary
* Ensure events align with program goals and participant engagement strategies
* Provide regular updates to leadership on alumni engagement and event outcomes

20

**Administrative & Operational Support**

* Regularly communicate with alumni via email to ensure they are receiving updates, resources, and support
* Maintain organized program documentation and records
* Support cross-departmental collaboration to ensure smooth program operations
* Perform additional duties as assigned to meet organizational and funder requirements

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Knowledge of or experience working with the LGBTQ community and familiarity with issues of particular relevance to LGBTQ people
* A passion for the Center’s work and its mission to make the world a better place for LGBTQ people
* Minimum 2 years’ experience in program development, volunteer management and working with at-risk youth
* Experience in psychology, sociology or related field or bachelor’s degree
* Working knowledge of the Los Angeles County network of social services
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills
* Proficiency with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and databases
* Sensitivity to and appreciation of the needs and challenges of gay, lesbian, transgender, bisexual and questioning youth and other marginalized and at-risk youth
* Ability to work effectively and collegially with people of diverse education levels, abilities, races, ethnicities, spiritual affiliations, gender identities, ages and sexual orientations
* Available to work a flexible schedule that includes weekends and evenings
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with people of diverse races, ethnicities, nationalities, sexual orientations, gender identities, gender expression, socio-economic backgrounds, religions, ages, English-speaking abilities, immigration status, and physical abilities in a multicultural environment

The Los Angeles LGBT Center is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering diversity within its staff. Applications are encouraged from all persons regardless of their race, color, ancestry, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, sex, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, religion, disability, age, military or veteran status, including status as a victim of domestic violence, assault or stalking, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation or activities, medical or health conditions, and marital status.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Construction Program Specialist
jobs.description:
**WHY JOIN ALO?**

Mindful movement. It's at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it's our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That's the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

**OVERVIEW**

The Construction Program Specialist supports the successful execution of ALO's Store Development projects by coordinating timelines, documentation, and communications across Construction, Store Design, and Real Estate. This role ensures alignment and efficiency throughout the project lifecycle—from site approval through store opening—by managing key systems, maintaining schedules, and fostering collaboration across all functional partners.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Project Coordination & Scheduling

* Coordinate and track all project milestones, deliverables, and dependencies within the master project schedule (Smartsheet or similar)
* Launch new projects internally upon Real Estate Committee approval, ensuring all required documentation and communication protocols are in place.
* Communicate milestone deadlines and critical path updates to stakeholders across departments.
* Identify potential schedule risks and collaborate with internal teams to develop solutions.
* Coordinate project kickoffs, status updates, and cross-functional meetings; document and distribute meeting notes and action items.

Platform & System Administration

* Serve as primary administrator for Store Development platforms, including Procore, Smartsheet, and shared project databases.
* Manage system setup, project creation, user permissions, and access for internal and external stakeholders.
* Maintain standardized folder structures and ensure ongoing compliance with file management policies.
* Partner with IT and project teams to streamline workflows, integrate data between platforms, and improve reporting accuracy.
* Support ongoing development of dashboards, reports, and templates to enhance visibility and accountability across programs.
* Train and support team members and vendors on platform use and best practices.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Facilitate effective communication and coordination across Real Estate, Store Design, Construction, Finance, Facilities, and Operations teams.
* Partner with cross-program leads to align timelines, deliverables, and project dependencies across multiple initiatives (e.g., remodels, pop-ups, relocations).
* Act as a liaison between landlords, vendors, and internal partners to ensure smooth handoffs and clear documentation flow.
* Support the integration of sustainability, technology, and brand standards into all project processes.

Administrative & Operational Support

* Obtain, track, and file critical documents from Real Estate, landlords, and consultants.
* Coordinate utility setups and partner with Accounts Payable to ensure timely account activation and billing accuracy.
* Support vendor onboarding, purchase order tracking, and contract management as needed.
* Maintain confidentiality and professionalism while handling sensitive company and project information.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 2–4 years of experience in construction, store development, design coordination, or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Proficiency with Procore, Smartsheet, and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Project).
* Strong organizational and communication skills, with acute attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Collaborative mindset with a proactive, professional, and solution-oriented approach.

The base salary range for this position is $75,000 - $85,000 per year which represents the current range for the base salary for this exempt position. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. As such, on occasion and when applicable, there is the possibility that the final, agreed-upon base salary may be outside of the upper end of the range. Please also note the range listed is just one component of the company's total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a PTO policy, and many other progressive benefits.

jobs.title: Graphic Designer & Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About GFFG:**

GFFG is a Seoul-based hospitality group behind some of Korea’s most beloved food and beverage brands, including Cafe Knotted and Hojokban. GFFG America Inc. brings these concepts to the U.S. Cafe Knotted, a dessert cafe and bakery from Seoul, is open in Los Angeles at Westfield Century City and in the Arts District. Hojokban, the Korean restaurant founded in Seoul’s Cheongdam neighborhood, opened in New York City in 2023 and in Los Angeles’ Arts District in November 2025. Learn more at www.gffg.co.kr.

**Position Overview:**

GFFG America is looking for a creative, detail-oriented Graphic Designer & Social Media Coordinator to shape the visual identity and online presence of our brands in the U.S. This role sits within our Brand Strategy team and works across Cafe Knotted and Hojokban, producing design assets, creating and publishing social content, managing our online reputation, and building relationships with creators and media.

This is an on-site position based in Los Angeles, typically working out of our Arts District locations with regular visits to Cafe Knotted Westfield Century City. The ideal candidate is a strong designer who is equally comfortable behind a camera, inside a content calendar, and in a guest review inbox.

**Schedule:**

The typical schedule is Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm. Hours are flexible and will shift as needed to capture content and support events, including some evenings and weekends.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

*Graphic Design & Print Production:*

* Produce polished, on-brand design assets using Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) across social media, web, advertising, menus, signage, and packaging
* Apply strong typography, color, layout, and composition to elevate all marketing materials
* Maintain and enforce brand guidelines for each brand, ensuring visual consistency across every touchpoint
* Manage updates to menus, promotional materials, website visuals, and in-store displays so guest-facing information is always accurate
* Adapt designs across digital, print, packaging, multimedia, and experiential formats
* Organize and maintain a structured digital asset library
* Coordinate with external vendors and printers on menu printing, signage, and collateral to ensure production quality and on-time delivery

*Social Media & Content Creation:*

* Lead the management and curation of all Company social channels (Cafe Knotted, Hojokban) on Instagram and TikTok, keeping them visually cohesive, consistently updated, and aligned with brand strategy
* Plan, create, schedule, and publish 2–3 posts and Reels per week per brand, maintaining a content calendar at least one week ahead
* Capture and edit photo and video content on-site at our locations for social, web, and marketing use
* Monitor DMs, comments, and tagged content daily; engage with the community and repost guest content
* Analyze social performance and engagement data to inform content strategy and improve reach
* Stay current with design trends, platform changes, and hospitality marketing best practices

*Reputation Management:*

* Monitor and respond to guest reviews on Google, Yelp, OpenTable, and DoorDash promptly and professionally, in a voice consistent with each brand and our hospitality standards
* Maintain and optimize business listings (Google Business Profile, Yelp, OpenTable, DoorDash) for accuracy, imagery, and completeness
* Track review trends and surface recurring guest feedback to on-site leadership

*Website, SEO / GEO & Digital Marketing:*

* Maintain website content and visuals for both brands
* Support search engine optimization (SEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) efforts so our brands are discoverable on Google, Maps, and AI-driven search
* Set up and manage Google Ads campaigns, monitoring performance and adjusting as needed

*Creator & Media Outreach:*

* Identify, evaluate, and reach out to local creators, influencers, and media who fit each brand
* Manage gifted and paid collaborations end to end — outreach, negotiation and budget approval, scheduling visits with on-site teams, and tracking posted content and results
* Assist in organizing and executing special marketing events, campaigns, and collaborations

**Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of graphic design experience (hospitality, food & beverage, or lifestyle brands preferred)
* Strong portfolio demonstrating brand-driven design across digital and print
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign); experience with Figma, Canva, CapCut, or Premiere a plus
* Hands-on experience managing brand social media accounts (Instagram, TikTok) including content creation, scheduling, and analytics
* Photography and short-form video skills, including RAW photo editing; comfortable shooting on-site with a phone and/or camera
* Familiarity with Google Business Profile, Yelp, OpenTable, and DoorDash merchant tools, Google Ads, and basic SEO principles
* Strong written communication skills; able to write in multiple brand voices
* Highly organized, able to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
* Korean language proficiency strongly preferred but not required; familiarity with Korean food culture a plus
* Must have reliable transportation for travel between Los Angeles locations

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* $55,000–$70,000 annual salary, based on experience
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid time off and federal holidays
* Dining incentive at GFFG brands
* Mileage reimbursement and technology stipend
* Benefits eligibility begins after a 60-day introductory period

**Physical Requirements & Working Conditions include:**

* Office-based within our restaurant and cafe locations, with regular time on the floor and in the kitchen capturing content
* Ability to travel between Los Angeles-area locations as needed
* Extended periods of computer work; occasional standing, walking, and carrying equipment up to 25 p

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**This position is based full-time in our corporate office located at 9200 Sunset Blvd., West Hollywood, CA 90069.** ***Relocation assistance is not available for this role.***

Description:

**Innovative Dining Group (IDG) is seeking a detail-oriented and creative MARKETING COORDINATOR to support marketing initiatives across our growing portfolio of restaurants.**This hands-on role will help keep our digital presence accurate and up to date, support social media and content development, conduct competitive and industry research, and assist with restaurant-level marketing needs. The ideal candidate is curious, organized, resourceful, and excited to learn, with a strong interest in hospitality, marketing, social media, and emerging technology.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include but are not limited to:

**Digital + Website**

* Conduct regular audits of all brand and restaurant websites to ensure hours, menus, reservation links, contact information, private dining details, photography, and copy are accurate and up to date.
* Audit Google Business Profiles for accuracy, including hours, categories, links, photos, menus, and other key business information.
* Ensure restaurant names and business information are consistent across Google, Apple Maps, Yelp, Tripadvisor, and other relevant platforms.
* Conduct regular Yelp and Tripadvisor audits to identify inaccurate information, outdated imagery, or other content requiring updates.
* Test SevenRooms reservation links across websites, social media, Google, and other customer-facing channels to ensure links are active and functioning properly.
* Review the mobile experience across all websites and flag formatting, functionality, or content issues.
* Set up and maintain enterprise Canva accounts across locations and provide basic training and support to GMs as needed.
* Audit restaurant menus across digital channels to ensure they accurately match current approved menu PDFs.
* Audit email signup forms across all websites to ensure they are functioning properly and capturing customer information as intended.

**Social Media**

* Conduct regular social media audits to ensure account information, links, contact details, and other profile information are accurate and up to date.
* Monitor Instagram and TikTok for trending sounds, formats, and content opportunities relevant to BOA, Sushi Roku, Katana, and other IDG brands.
* Identify and organize relevant user-generated content, including screenshots and creator handles, for potential reposting by individual restaurant locations.
* Research emerging restaurant content trends and formats and present 5–10 relevant content ideas each week.

**Restaurant + Operations Marketing**

* Maintain an accurate inventory of restaurant uniforms, including updating tracking spreadsheets and organizing uniform storage areas.
* Develop and maintain a master reference of restaurant hours, happy hours, brunch and lunch offerings, private dining capacities, parking and valet information, and other key guest-facing details.
* Assist Marketing Manager with planning, production, organization, and coordination of the Holiday Cookbook.
* Support restaurant-level marketing needs and projects as assigned, helping ensure brand standards and marketing materials are consistently executed across locations.

**Competitive Research + Industry Trends**

* Conduct ongoing competitive research using Bluenote and other relevant sources to identify trends and opportunities across the restaurant and hospitality industry.
* Monitor competitors and relevant brands for new restaurant openings, launches, collaborations, events, promotions, partnerships, and creative marketing initiatives.

Success means expanding KEITA’s network, and creating new opportunities for the studio by building lasting relationships, generating qualified sales opportunities, and converting those opportunities into furniture sales and projects.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**MANAGER, STARLINK CUSTOMER SUCCESS (ASIA-PACIFIC & OCEANIA)**

Starlink provides high-speed, low-latency internet to customers around the world. Our enterprise resellers bring Starlink to businesses across a wide range of markets and use cases.

As the **Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Asia-Pacific & Oceania),** you will lead the team responsible for our enterprise reseller business across Asia-Pacific, including Australia, New Zealand, and the Pacific Islands. The region spans a broad set of countries, time zones, regulatory environments, and customer needs, with resellers often operating across multiple markets. You will manage Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists and be accountable for the performance and growth of the existing book.

Your team is responsible for growing revenue with existing customers, expanding their use of Starlink, and maintaining strong commercial relationships. Across Asia-Pacific and Oceania, turning an opportunity into revenue can depend on product availability, capacity, local billing requirements, regulatory readiness, logistics, and activation. You will help the team navigate those constraints while keeping the focus on growth.

This is a player-coach role. You will set clear priorities, coach and develop your team, and hold a high bar for performance. You will also stay close to key customers and step into the most important growth opportunities, renewals, payment issues, and escalations. We expect you to know your book, understand where the next opportunities and risks are, and keep a geographically distributed team focused on the right work.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead, hire, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists across Asia-Pacific and Oceania
* Grow revenue across an existing book of enterprise resellers
* Help the team identify and close opportunities for customers to expand their use of Starlink across hardware, service, data, and products
* Build hardware and service forecasts that leadership can rely on, with a clear view of opportunities and risks across markets
* Develop a clear view of where demand is growing across the region and what is required to turn that demand into revenue
* Work through billing, payment, regulatory, capacity, logistics, product availability, and activation issues when they are blocking growth
* Partner with Sales, Channel Sales, Finance, Tax, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Logistics to move customer opportunities forward
* Align closely with regional Sales and Channel Sales teams so resellers receive a clear and consistent message across markets
* Identify problems that repeat across countries and work with the right teams to solve them at scale
* Build strong coverage and operating discipline across a team working with customers in widely separated time zones
* Stay close enough to the work to know when to coach, when to step in, and when to let the team run independently

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
* 6+ years in customer success, account management, sales, or another commercial role for a technical product
* 3+ years owning and growing a book of existing customers, with direct responsibility for revenue, retention, or expansion
* 2+ years of direct people management
* Experience managing enterprise customers across multiple countries or markets

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Strong track record of growing revenue within existing enterprise accounts
* Experience leading a commercial book across Asia-Pacific and Oceania
* Experience managing customers across geographically distributed markets with different regulatory, billing, logistics, and product requirements
* Commercial mindset with the ability to understand a customer's business, find opportunities, and turn them into revenue
* Experience leading geographically distributed teams responsible for customer and revenue goals

* Experience in telecommunications, satellite, connectivity, networking, or another technical industry

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Must be willing to travel regularly throughout Asia-Pacific and Oceania and to other SpaceX locations

jobs.title: Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Europe, Middle East & Africa)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**MANAGER, STARLINK CUSTOMER SUCCESS (EUROPE, MIDDLE EAST & AFRICA)**

Starlink provides high-speed, low-latency internet to customers around the world. Our enterprise resellers bring Starlink to businesses across a wide range of markets and use cases.

As the **Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Europe, Middle East & Africa),** you will lead the team responsible for our enterprise reseller business across EMEA. This is a large and diverse region where customers may operate across multiple countries, currencies, legal entities, regulatory environments, and Starlink products. You will manage Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists and be accountable for the performance and growth of the existing book.

Your team is responsible for growing revenue with existing customers, expanding their use of Starlink, and maintaining strong commercial relationships. Doing that across EMEA requires navigating significant differences between markets, including local billing and tax requirements, payment practices, import and logistics constraints, regulatory requirements, and product availability. You will be expected to understand those differences without losing sight of the commercial opportunity across the region.

This is a player-coach role. You will set clear priorities, coach and develop your team, and hold a high bar for performance. You will also stay close to key customers and step into the most important growth opportunities, renewals, payment issues, and escalations. We expect you to know your book, understand where growth is accelerating or blocked, and make sure your team follows through.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead, hire, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa
* Grow revenue across an existing book of enterprise resellers operating across a diverse set of markets
* Help the team identify and close opportunities for customers to expand their use of Starlink across hardware, service, data, and products
* Build hardware and service forecasts that leadership can rely on, accounting for differences in customer demand and execution across countries
* Develop a clear view of where the largest opportunities and risks are across the region and focus the team accordingly
* Work through local billing, tax, payment, regulatory, capacity, logistics, and activation issues when they are blocking revenue
* Partner with Sales, Channel Sales, Finance, Tax, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Logistics to move customer opportunities forward
* Align closely with regional Sales and Channel Sales teams so resellers receive a clear and consistent message across markets
* Identify issues that repeat across countries and work with the right teams to create solutions that can scale across the region
* Stay close enough to the work to know when to coach, when to step in, and when to let the team run independently

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
* 6+ years in customer success, account management, sales, or another commercial role for a technical product
* 3+ years owning and growing a book of existing customers, with direct responsibility for revenue, retention, or expansion
* 2+ years of direct people management
* Experience managing enterprise customers across multiple countries or markets

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Strong track record of growing revenue within existing enterprise accounts
* Experience leading a commercial book across Europe, the Middle East, and/or Africa
* Experience operating across markets with different currencies, billing structures, tax requirements, regulatory environments, and payment practices
* Commercial mindset with the ability to understand a customer's business, find opportunities, and turn them into revenue
* Experience leading geographically distributed teams responsible for customer and revenue goals
* Strong financial understanding, including pricing, billing, collections, payment terms, and international customer payments
* Experience working through complex customer issues across tax, logistics, regulatory requirements, capacity, or operations
* Ability to establish a consistent commercial approach while adapting execution to local market requirements
* Clear and direct communicator who can work effectively across different countries, cultures, and customer environments
* Experience in telecommunications, satellite, connectivity, networking, or another technical industry

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Must be willing to work onsite five days per week
* Must be willing to travel regularly throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa and to other SpaceX locations

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the role**

We're searching for a Logistics & Purchasing Coordinator to keep our freight, purchasing, and service operations running smoothly. You'll book LTL freight, manage domestic and international purchase orders and vendor follow-ups, track inventory, field service and warranty issues, and keep our warehouse team and Director of Operations up to date. This is primarily about [80]% computer and phone work, and [20]% on the warehouse floor checking receiving, staging, and inventory. It's a great fit if you've worked as a logistics coordinator, purchasing assistant, or operations admin and like owning the details.

**What you'll do**

**Freight & logistics**

* Book LTL freight shipments, pickups, and deliveries with carriers
* Track shipments and handle delays, missed pickups, damages, and delivery exceptions
* Keep records of bookings, tracking numbers, and carrier details

**Purchasing & vendors**

* Create and manage purchase orders, confirmations, and ETAs
* Follow up with vendors on availability, lead times, pricing, and backorders
* Catch discrepancies between POs, invoices, and received inventory

**Service issues**

* Track customer issues involving damages, missing parts, warranty claims, and replacements
* Coordinate with vendors, technicians, and customer support until each case is resolved
* Escalate high-risk issues before they become chargebacks or cancellations

**Warehouse & inventory**

* Coordinate daily with warehouse staff on receiving, shipping, staging, and order readiness
* Track which units are available, allocated, damaged, returned, or pending shipment
* Support inventory counts and report discrepancies

**Reporting**

* Keep order, shipment, purchasing, and service trackers current by end of day
* Send daily or weekly updates to the Director of Operations, whom you'll report to

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience in freight/logistics coordination, purchasing administration, or operations support
* Hands-on experience booking shipments or managing domestic and international purchase orders
* Comfortable in spreadsheets and at least one ERP, inventory, or order management system
* Able to work on-site full time in Hawthorne
* LTL freight experience

**Nice to have**

* Experience with large-item products such as fitness equipment, furniture, or appliances
* Experience handling warranty or damage claims
* Familiarity with Shopify, Xero, or Salesforce

**About us**

**Total Body Experts LLC** is a leading provider of high-quality fitness equipment and servicing designed for residential & commercial use. At Total Body Experts, we're not just about the equipment; we're on a mission to revolutionize the way the world experiences health and fitness. With a holistic commitment to exercise and customer satisfaction, we serve a diverse range of clients in both B2B & DTC sectors. This is a great opportunity for someone who is organized, hands-on, and passionate about efficiency and problem-solving in a warehouse setting.

Expected hours: No more than 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills.

Careers feel different when the culture actually means something.  
At The Liberty Company, our people-first approach has earned us multiple years of recognition as a top insurance employer—and it shows in how we work every day. We value fresh ideas, teamwork, and taking care of the people who make our success possible. Along with an award-winning culture, we offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, generous PTO and holidays, continued education, and wellness-focused programs designed to help you bring your best self to work. If you’re ready to grow with a company that truly invests in its people, you’re in the right place. We're looking for an up and coming Assistant Employee Benefits Operations Coordinator to join our growing team!

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Assistant EB Operations Coordinator supports the day-to-day operational engine of the Employee Benefits practice. This role is a hands-on driver behind carrier appointments, carrier access and logins, signature and legal routing, and the daily task flow that keeps Account Management and Sales teams moving without friction.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Carrier Appointments & Contracting**

* Submit, track, and drive carrier appointment and contracting requests through written confirmation, researching unfamiliar carriers and agencies to identify requirements and contacts as needed
* Maintain the tracker daily so status is current without being asked; follow up on a set cadence and escalate stalls
* Gather and submit required documentation (licensing, W-9s, E&O, ACH, agency information) accurately and completely the first time, and confirm effective dates, writing numbers, and agency codes once received

**Carrier Access, Logins & Portal Support**

* Process carrier portal access and login requests for producers, account managers, and service staff, troubleshooting issues (locked accounts, permissions, expired credentials) until resolved
* Maintain accurate records of carrier portal access by user and office
* Support access setup and removal during onboarding/offboarding with the EB Operations Manager, IT, and HR

**Legal & Signature Coordination**

* Submit carrier agreements and appointment paperwork to Legal for review and signature with complete context and clear deadlines, tracking documents through to return of fully executed copies to the carrier
* Maintain organized, retrievable records of executed agreements and keep requesters informed on status without them having to ask

**Daily Operations & Task Follow-Through**

* Monitor shared mailboxes and the request queue; triage and respond within turnaround standards, owning tickets end to end and closing them only once resolved
* Support routine system/account setup and data entry as directed; maintain checklists and documentation for the processes this role runs, and flag recurring issues or process gaps to the EB Operations Manager with suggested fixes

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Communication**

* Partner with Account Management, Sales, Legal, Accounting, IT, and HR to move requests forward and remove operational roadblocks
* Communicate status proactively and in writing - what is done, pending, blocked, and needed
* Draft and publish operational updates in Workvivo (appointments, access changes, deadlines) in a clear, on-brand voice
* Support the EB Operations team on partnership onboarding and book rolls, and participate in special projects as assigned

**Execution Expectations**

* Own outcomes, not activity. A task is complete when the result is confirmed - not when the request is sent
* Follow up persistently and professionally. Most carrier and vendor items require multiple touches; build the cadence and hold it
* Escalate early, with a recommendation rather than only a problem
* Document as you go so any teammate can pick up an open item without a verbal handoff
* Ask questions when unsure; do not guess on items affecting carrier relationships, compensation, or compliance
* Manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment and communicate early when timelines are at risk

jobs.title: Textile Designer & Custom Rug Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Mehraban**

Mehraban is a third-generation Los Angeles rug company specializing in luxury handmade rugs for leading interior designers, architects, hospitality projects, and private residences.

Since 1945, we have combined generations of rug knowledge and craftsmanship with a contemporary approach to design. Our collections include one-of-a-kind, contemporary, antique, and fully custom rugs produced by skilled weaving partners around the world.

We are looking for a talented, highly organized **Textile Designer & Custom Rug Production Coordinator** to join our Los Angeles team.

**The Role**

This is a hybrid **creative, technical, and production-focused position**.

The ideal candidate has a strong eye for design, color, pattern, fashion, and interiors, while also being extremely detail-oriented and comfortable managing the technical and organizational side of custom rug production.

You will work closely with our sales and design teams, clients, interior designers, and international weaving mills to develop custom rugs from initial concept through production.

You will also contribute to Mehraban's creative development by researching emerging trends, colors, materials, fashion, art, and interiors and helping develop new rug concepts and collections.

**Custom Rug Design & Artwork**

* Create professional tear sheets and presentations for custom rug projects.
* Resize, rescale, repeat, crop, and adapt existing artwork to different rug dimensions and shapes.
* Engineer pattern repeats while maintaining the integrity and proportion of the original design.
* Develop custom colorways and recolor existing designs.
* Create rug renderings using Galaincha or similar textile/rug visualization software.
* Prepare Illustrator templates showing artwork, dimensions, colors, materials, and client/project information.
* Occasionally develop original rug designs and concepts for custom projects and Mehraban collections.
* Assist our sales team, clients, and interior designers with custom rug development.

**Creative Research & Product Development**

An important part of this position is bringing a strong creative point of view to the company.

* Research trends across **fashion, interiors, art, architecture, textiles, color, and materials**.
* Identify emerging colors, patterns, textures, and design directions relevant to the luxury interiors market.
* Develop mood boards, color stories, pattern ideas, and new rug concepts.
* Explore archival designs and reinterpret them through new colors, scales, constructions, and materials.
* Collaborate with the Mehraban team on new collections and product development.
* Help maintain a fresh and sophisticated visual direction while respecting Mehraban's design identity.

**Rug Production & Mill Coordination**

* Translate approved artwork into accurate, mill-ready production documents.
* Prepare order documents for custom, stock, and sample rugs.
* Specify dimensions, design scale, colors, fibers, construction, pile height, and other production details.
* Initiate orders with our weaving mills and communicate specifications clearly.
* Maintain regular email correspondence with mills regarding new orders, samples, revisions, production status, and technical questions.
* Follow up on active production and help resolve design or specification issues.
* Maintain accurate internal order records, digital files, and production archives.
* Follow established naming, filing, and ordering procedures.

**Quality Control**

* Review incoming samples, strike-offs, and finished rugs.
* Compare finished pieces against approved artwork, colors, dimensions, and construction specifications.
* Identify discrepancies in color, scale, material, construction, or workmanship.
* Develop an increasingly sophisticated understanding of fibers, weaving techniques, rug construction, pile, texture, and finishing.

**Sample Library & Organization**

Maintaining our physical and digital design resources is an important responsibility of this position.

* Maintain and organize the showroom's rug and textile sample library.
* Properly label, catalog, archive, and track samples and strike-offs.
* Keep samples accessible and organized for the sales and design teams.
* Maintain corresponding digital artwork, specifications, and production records.
* Periodically review and reorganize samples as collections and vendors evolve.

**Additional Creative Support**

As needed, assist with:

* Catalogs and collection presentations.
* Sales presentations and PDF materials.
* Graphic and print materials.
* Website product assets and coordination.
* Coordination of imagery and assets for marketing, social media, SEO/AEO, and other digital initiatives.
* Communication with the warehouse and receiving team regarding incoming rugs and product information.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in **Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop**.
* Strong understanding of vector and raster artwork, pattern repeats, file formats, image resolution, pixel dimensions, and production-ready artwork.
* Excellent eye for **color, scale, proportion, pattern, texture, and composition**.
* Ability to distinguish subtle differences in color, including warm and cool undertones.
* Strong fashion and design sensibility with an awareness of contemporary interiors, art, textiles, and luxury design.
* Extremely detail-oriented and organized.
* Comfortable managing multiple projects and production deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong written communication skills and professional email correspondence.
* Ability to maintain organized physical and digital filing systems.
* Willingness and enthusiasm to learn about handmade rugs, fibers, weaving techniques, and construction.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in one or more of the following is highly desirable:

* Textile design
* Surface or pattern design
* Rug or carpet design
* Fashion textiles
* Interior design
* Luxury home furnishings

KaufmanIT, LLC, founded in 2010, is a growing IT services company located in Irvine, California. We provide reliable technology support and strategic guidance to clients across a variety of industries, including fashion, engineering, legal, financial, nonprofit, and professional services.

We take a methodical approach to technology and focus on understanding each client's business, technology environment, risks, and long-term goals. Our goal is to help our clients improve productivity, security, reliability, and efficiency through thoughtful technology solutions and exceptional service.

**About the Role**

KaufmanIT is seeking an experienced IT professional to join our team as a Technical Account Manager / vCIO.

**This is a full-time, in-person position in our Irvine office and is not a remote position.**

This role is ideal for someone with a strong technical foundation, approximately an L2 support level or above, who also excels at working with people.

You do **not** need to currently hold a vCIO title.

We are especially interested in candidates who have worked in an MSP environment and understand the unique demands of supporting multiple clients, environments, priorities, and technology stacks at the same time.

The right person will be able to understand a client's technical environment, build strong relationships, communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, identify technology needs and risks, and help translate those needs into actionable technology plans.

This position provides an opportunity for an experienced technical professional to move into a more strategic and client-facing role while remaining connected to technology and our clients' environments.

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as a trusted technology advisor and primary strategic technology contact for assigned clients.
* Build strong relationships with client leadership, employees, and internal KaufmanIT teams.

* Help clients understand cybersecurity, business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology risks.
* Remain technically engaged and assist with troubleshooting, technical reviews, or project work when appropriate.
* Coordinate with service delivery and project teams to ensure client needs are addressed and expectations are met.
* Identify opportunities to improve client satisfaction and strengthen long-term client relationships.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3+ years of hands-on IT support, systems administration, systems engineering, or comparable technical experience.

* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to evaluate technical issues beyond basic help desk support.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows environments, networking, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, backup/business continuity, and general business IT infrastructure.
* Ability to understand how technology affects business operations—not just how to resolve a technical issue.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with everyone from end users and technicians to business owners and executive leadership.
* Strong relationship-building and customer service skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts and recommendations clearly to non-technical clients.
* Strong organization, documentation, follow-through, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and maintain ownership of multiple client needs simultaneously.
* Professional, dependable, curious, and comfortable taking initiative.
* Valid driver's license, proof of insurance, and ability to travel to client locations as needed.
* Ability to work full-time **on-site in Irvine, California**.

**Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.description:
**Org Marketing Statement**

At Parker Aerospace, we develop technologies and innovative solutions that enable reliable, efficient and increasingly sustainable flight for the lifecycle of the aircraft, including aftermarket support. Our passionate people with deep engineering expertise, together with our breadth of differentiated technologies, ensure that we make the extraordinary happen and continue to shape the future of aviation in partnership with our customers.

As a member of our team, you are instrumental in fulfilling our mission: 'Enabling Engineering Breakthroughs that Lead to a Better Tomorrow.' Pursuing a career at Parker presents unlimited opportunities for both professional and personal development. Working with some of the most brilliant minds in the industry, your contributions will be pivotal in developing innovative technologies and products, significantly contributing to Parker’s goal of addressing the world’s most pressing engineering challenges. At Parker, our team members belong, matter and make a difference.

**Services & Support Operations Division**

The Services and Support Operations (SSO) is a global leader of integrated MRO services and support. We are renowned for our exceptional customer service and expertise at every stage of the aircraft lifecycle, providing innovative OEM-quality service solutions across a comprehensive portfolio. We are proud to serve airlines/ business jet operators, the military, airframe/ engine manufacturers, as well as independent service centers. With our extensive network of service teams worldwide, MRO facilities, proprietary predictive modeling, and advanced systems, we offer 24/7 operational and technical support wherever it's needed.

**Account Manager (SSO – Location: Irvine, CA)**

**Position Summary**

Manages and executes all sales activities and contracted bookings for Premier and Strategic customer accounts. Partners with internal SSO and division teams to improve customer scorecard performance and increase LTR. Identifies growth opportunities across major programs, product lines, and market segments within the division, while supporting the execution of awarded business negotiated by Business Development Managers within the territory. Performs root cause analysis for underperforming spare parts and MRO components and develops, coordinates, and implements corrective action plans to improve performance.

**Scope/Supervision and Interaction:**

\_\_\_\_ Has Direct Reports \_\_X\_\_ Does Not Have Direct Reports

Provides leadership for an aftermarket business segment; is the primary contact for assigned customers of moderate complexity and scope. May provide guidance and assign work to other Parker employees (e.g. administrators, technicians or engineers). Coordination may cross multiple sites and divisions. Has regular interaction with customers and Division leadership. Typically reports to division staff or an aftermarket business development manager.

**Essential Functions:**

* Acts as primary interface with customers by maintaining on-site presence and developing and maintaining on-going, long-term relationships at all levels of the customer’s organization with a focus on Premier and Strategic customer base.
* Serves as the customer’s advocate within Parker by acting as the liaison and facilitator for the resolution of issues regarding any aspect of Parker support. Identifies technical, logistical, performance, or support issues with Parker products or services.
* Ensures long-term profitable growth of spares, repairs, product improvements, and retrofit business of all Parker Aerospace product lines at assigned customers by working with Aftermarket Business Development Managers to develop and implement marketing plans and strategies.
* Identify new business opportunities through working the closure of major customer issues
* Responsible for meeting sales and contracted bookings targets for portfolio of customers identified by Manager. Capable of obtaining customer intel/forecasts and translating that into division specific action plans as it relates to FY plan and outlook
* Owns customer scorecard performance metrics (delivery TAT, quality / quarantined events, warranty adjudication, reliability, customer service) and partners with the service centers, CRC, spares - surplus, reliability, customer service engineering, field service, and divisions to maintain a high level of operational performance.
* Performs root cause analysis for underperforming spare parts and MRO components and develops, coordinates, and implements and maintains corrective action plans to improve performance
* Provides contractual performance auditing to confirm adherence of key contractual terms such as pricing / exclusivity vs actual events.
* Serves as customer expert and resource – i.e. “owns” the VOC to SSO and Divisions.
* Complies with federal, state, and aerospace industry regulations by studying existing and new legislation, enforcing adherence to requirements, and advising management on needed actions (e.g. export compliance).
* Coordinates the completion of administration tasks of discounts, royalties, rebates, remedies, and CY escalation.
* Responsible for leading F2F customer reviews. Prepares all presentations needed for F2F reviews by partnering with technical / service center teams.
* Coordinates the development and population of Plan for Every Customer “PFEC” alongside Business Development Manager.

**Qualifications:**

Bachelors degree (BA) in Marketing, Engineering, or related field. Demonstrated ability to perform the essential functions of the job typically acquired through eight or more years of increasingly responsible experience, including two or more years of high-level program management or prior customer account management experience

jobs.title: [MARKETING] Digital Marketing Manager, Brand Experience and Demand Generation
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**
---------------------

The Digital Marketing Manager (Brand Experience & Demand Generation) plays a critical role at the intersection of Brand, Media, and Digital Commerce. This position is responsible for driving high-quality consumer demand and shaping the digital brand experience across key touchpoints, ensuring that awareness and consideration efforts translate into measurable business impact.

Acting as a strategic bridge between Brand Marketing, eCommerce, and Media teams, this role focuses on building and activating upper- and mid-funnel strategies that generate qualified traffic and accelerate the path to purchase. The position owns paid media strategy, website experience (TCL.com), and CRM-driven lifecycle marketing to ensure a cohesive and effective consumer journey from discovery through purchase intent.

The successful candidate brings a strong understanding of how modern digital marketing ecosystems operate, with the ability to translate brand and commercial objectives into integrated campaigns, content strategies, and data-driven optimizations that deliver results.

This role is ideal for a marketing professional who is equally comfortable managing media investments and performance metrics as they are shaping digital experiences, content strategies, and consumer journeys.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**
------------------------------

**Paid Media Strategy & Demand Generation**

* Develop and execute upper- and mid-funnel paid media strategies across Video, Social, Display, and Native channels to drive qualified traffic and build consumer consideration.
* Design and implement innovative media approaches that shorten the path from product discovery to purchase, accelerating the "see-to-buy" cycle.
* Build and refine audience segmentation strategies to effectively engage consumers early in the decision-making process and nurture future conversion.
* Own media execution, including budget allocation, performance optimization, and traffic quality, ensuring efficient use of investment aligned with business priorities.

**Website Experience & Content Strategy (TCL.com)**

* Own TCL.com as the central hub for brand storytelling, product education, and consumer engagement-not just as a transactional platform.
* Design and optimize end-to-end user journeys that drive engagement and increase purchase intent through intuitive navigation and compelling content.
* Lead SEO and organic growth initiatives by improving site structure and developing high-quality content (e.g., product pages, guides, editorial content) aligned with consumer research behavior.
* Implement traffic routing strategies that align with business goals, optimizing pathways to retail partners or direct purchase flows as needed.

**CRM & Lifecycle Marketing**

* Develop and manage CRM and email marketing strategies to capture and nurture upper-funnel demand into qualified purchase intent.
* Drive first-party data acquisition through targeted campaigns and on-site lead capture strategies, strengthening direct consumer engagement channels.
* Optimize lifecycle communications to improve engagement, retention, and readiness to convert.

**Analytics, Insights & Performance Optimization**

* Analyze performance across channels with a holistic view, focusing on traffic quality, engagement, and contribution to downstream conversion-not just last-click sales.
* Develop and refine attribution approaches to better understand the impact of upper- and mid-funnel efforts on total business performance (DTC and retail).
* Translate data insights into actionable recommendations to continuously optimize media mix, content strategy, and user experience.

**Business Impact & KPI Ownership**

* Define and track key performance indicators including traffic growth, engagement, SEO visibility, media efficiency, and CRM database expansion.
* Drive measurable improvements in qualified traffic, purchase intent signals, and marketing efficiency through disciplined execution and optimization.
* Promote a data-driven, test-and-learn culture to continuously refine strategies and maximize return on marketing investment.

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

**Physical and Work Environment Requirements:**
-----------------------------------------------

* This is an on-site position based in Irvine, CA. Regular in-person attendance is an essential function of the role.
* Frequent use of typical office equipments such as keyboard, screens, and monitors. Extended periods of sitting, standing, and moving around the office.
* Occasional travel may be required to support business needs.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Must Have:**

* 5–10 years of experience in digital marketing, paid media, demand generation, or related roles.
* Proven ability to manage and optimize multi-channel paid media campaigns with a focus on upper- and mid-funnel performance.
* Strong understanding of digital consumer journeys, including content strategy, SEO, and lifecycle marketing.
* Hands-on experience with analytics tools and the ability to translate data into actionable insights and business recommendations.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across brand, eCommerce, and analytics teams.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**WHY JOIN TAXRISE?**

At TaxRise, we don't just provide tax relief services; we provide hope, stability, and solutions to individuals and families facing financial uncertainty. Our team is passionate about reshaping the tax resolution industry through innovation, empathy, and unwavering commitment to our clients.

Join us and make a tangible difference in people's lives while growing your career with a team that values your contributions.

**WHY TOP SALES REPS CHOOSE TAXRISE**

At TaxRise, we help individuals and families overcome serious tax challenges, and every conversation you have creates real impact.

If you're driven, competitive, and motivated by high earnings, this is where your talent pays off.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is a **high-income, inbound sales opportunity** — no cold calling, no chasing leads.

As an Inbound Sales Representative, you'll work exclusively with **warm, pre-qualified leads** who are actively seeking help. Your role is to guide them through their options, build trust, and enroll them into the right solution.

You'll be backed by a strong support team, proven systems, and leadership that knows how to help you win.

Candidates must be available to work occasional overtime, including evenings and some weekends.

**COMPENSATION: BUILT FOR HIGH PERFORMERS**

* **Base Pay:** $17 per hour (full-time, 40 hours per week).
* **Commission:** $12,000 – $17,000+ per month
* **Top Earners:** Upwards of **$240,000+ annually**
* **No commission cap = unlimited income**

If you know how to sell, this is the kind of role where your paycheck reflects it.

**PAID SALES TRAINING & SUPPORT**

* Learn directly from **high-performing sales managers**
* Hands-on training with **real call scenarios, scripts, and objection handling**
* Ongoing **1:1 coaching and feedback** to sharpen your closing skills

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Take inbound calls from **motivated prospects ready to take action**
* Run structured discovery calls to understand each client's situation
* Recommend and enroll clients into tailored tax resolution programs
* Own your pipeline from first call to close
* Build trust through a consultative, empathetic sales approach
* Consistently hit and exceed sales targets

**WHAT MAKES YOU A STRONG FIT**

* 1–2+ years of sales experience (call center or high-volume preferred)
* Confident closer with strong communication skills
* Competitive, goal-oriented, and money-motivated
* Able to build trust quickly and handle sensitive conversations
* Organized and able to manage multiple opportunities at once

Even if you don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply — we value drive and potential.

**WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE**

* **Warm inbound leads only = no cold calling**
* **High earning potential with uncapped commission**
* Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing company
* Full benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* On-site gym & gaming lounge
* Weekly catered lunches + quarterly team outings.

**ABOUT TAXRISE**

We're one of the fastest-growing companies in the tax resolution space, on a mission to help people regain control of their financial future.

When you join TaxRise, you're joining a team that celebrates wins, supports each other, and rewards performance.

**READY TO EARN WHAT YOU'RE WORTH?**

If you're looking for a sales role with **real leads, real support, and real income potential**, this is it.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

We believe in taking care of our team so they can take care of our clients. Here's what you can expect as part of the TaxRise family:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (starting after 60 days)
* Paid Time Off
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Professional Development Program to support your growth
* Access to our on-site gym and gaming lounge
* Catered team lunches every Friday
* Fun and energizing quarterly company outings

**ABOUT US**

At TaxRise, our mission is simple yet impactful: to revolutionize the way taxpayers navigate their tax challenges. We believe in the power of lifting others up, and that's the driving force behind everything we do.

When you join us, you're not just becoming part of a company; you're joining a movement. We're a team that thrives on celebrating successes and making a genuine impact on people's lives.

We're proud to be the fastest-growing company in our industry, and we're on the lookout for exceptional individuals to help us continue our journey of transformation.

If you're ready to bring your unique talents and innovative spirit to a company where your work truly matters, TaxRise is the place to be. Join us and be part of a team that's reshaping the future of tax resolution.

jobs.description:
**Description**

The Assistant Community (Property) Manager assists the Community Manager in the successful site management of the apartment community providing the necessary leadership, guidance and motivation to ensure a positive working environment and quality community living. The Assistant Community Manager is responsible for administering the day-to-day leasing office operations and is responsible for overseeing all computer input of the apartment community. The Assistant Community Manager directs the leasing staff, and works with the Community Manager to recommend marketing and leasing strategies designed to meet the goals of Shea Properties. The pay range for this position is $27.00 - $29.00/hour and the Assistant Community Manager is also eligible to participate in the office Sales Bonus, Club Shea Program and the discretionary annual bonus plan. JF Shea offers a competitive benefits package including PTO, paid holidays, medical, dental, vision, 401K, disability, life insurance, 35% discounted apartment (based on availability), and cell phone allowance.

**Job Duties**

* Leads and participates in lineup each morning.
* Ensures craigslist ads are posted daily.
* In conjunction with the Community Manager, supervises the input of all data into designated property management software and processing of related reports.
* Reviews and approves move out statements (SODA), ensuring all statements are completed timely in accordance with state law and that all charges are necessary and accurate as outlined in Shea Properties policies.
* Reviews and approves resident rental applications for move-ins in a fair and consistent manner in accordance with Fair Housing requirements and Shea Business Properties' policies and procedures.
* Assists in negotiation of rent increases and lease renewals with residents and supports the Community Manager in the execution of all necessary documents to implement all approved rental increases.
* In conjunction with the Community Manager, coordinates with Leasing and Maintenance staff a calendar of scheduled move-ins, ensuring all move-in appointments are completed and all apartments are inspected prior to move-in.
* In conjunction with Community Manager reviews Yieldstar each morning and submits pricing recommendations.
* Maintains all residents and vendor files, ensuring completeness and accuracy of all paperwork and documentation.
* Under the direction of the Community Manager, ensures the preparation and delivery of all legal and formal notices, including Three Day or 30 Covenant to Quit, Rent Increase Notices, Late Charge Notices, and Notices of Violation of Community Rules and Regulations, in accordance to California Civil Code and Shea Properties policy and procedure.
* Ensures the maintenance of all account records and transactions including NSF's, Rent Allowances, Concessions, Rent Increases, Utility Billing Collection, and other management approved debits/credits.
* Prepares beginning of the week (Monday Morning) reports in an accurate and timely manner.
* In conjunction with the Community Manager, directs the functions of the leasing office, supervise the leasing staff’s daily activities and the preparation of all leasing paperwork and documents related to residency. Ensures schedule of leasing staff to ensure proper staff levels in anticipation of traffic demands and workload.
* Acts as gate keeper for Avid Exchange
* Prepares work orders and submits for approval in Go Cart.
* Assists in the development, preparation and administration of the capital and operating budgets for the property.
* Participates in staff selection process. Recruits, hires, and trains all leasing staff under the approval and direction of the Community Manager.
* Prepares annual reviews for all direct reports, sets Incentive-Based Compensation Bonus Plan (IBC) goals and objectives and implements Professional Development Plans (PDP) for all associates.
* Supports and motivates staff to participate in company sponsored classes and provided training, with the objective of completing PDP and individual goals. Ensures compliance with all mandatory training.
* Oversee and/or conduct weekly sales “leasing fundamentals” meetings, sign and submit fundamentals to Regional Manager for review.
* Supports industry networking and encourages direct reports to participate in industry association functions.
* Performs other duties as assigned. Actual job duties and responsibilities may vary depending on the size of the community.
* Handle on-call duties, as directed by supervisor.

**Technical/Professional Knowledge (*****Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience*****)**

* Effective oral and written communication skills; ability to give clear direction and respond to inquiries.Must be able to speak effectively before groups of customers or associates of the organization.
* Understanding of accounting principles and budget process. Ability to read and interpret numerical information. Basic understanding of the budgeting process.
* Basic understanding of marketing concepts; analyzing data; and report writing.
* Customer service experience required in at least one of the following industries: property management, hospitality, retail, and real estate.
* Negotiate and resolve conflicts.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (Word/Excel/Outlook) and Yardi & Yieldstar preferred.
* Prior experience in managing a staff (supervise, train, coach, develop, motivate, interview, hire, terminate) and lead by example.
* High School Diploma or equivalent. Some college level courses preferred.
* Minimum of 2 years property management experience with at least 1 year at the management level.

The Assistant Community Manager works on-site at an apartment community and interfaces with external/internal customers, residents, and vendors on a regular basis. The position work schedule varies depending on the property. Hours are usually scheduled from 9 a.m. – 6 p.m. However, office sta
