jobs.description:
**About Us**

Based in Costa Mesa, California, Aigo Global Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of aigo, a global technology brand founded in 1993. Aigo Global leads the company’s Smart Mobility division, developing and marketing innovative electric scooters and micro-mobility solutions for the North American market. Combining design, technology, and sustainability, Aigo is dedicated to creating smarter and more joyful ways for people to move and connect.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Bilingual Business Operations Manager/Assistant to lead day-to-day operational coordination for key retail accounts, with Costco as a primary focus. This role is responsible for supporting retail order execution from planning through fulfillment, working closely with internal teams, warehouses, logistics partners, and retail contacts to ensure accurate and timely delivery.

In addition to key account operations, the position supports related warehouse and logistics activities, routine financial operations, and external business coordination. The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, and comfortable taking ownership of operational follow-through in a fast-paced, growing business.

**What You’ll Do**

· **Key Retail Account Operations:** Serve as the primary operational point of contact for Costco and other key retail accounts. Manage day-to-day communications, coordinate account requirements, maintain strong partner relationships, and resolve operational issues.

· **Retail Order & Account Administration:** Manage purchase orders (POs), order documentation, retailer portals, and account-specific compliance requirements. Ensure accurate order processing, maintain organized account records, and coordinate with internal teams on order-related matters.

· **Retail Account Performance & Process Improvement:** Monitor key account performance, maintain operational reports, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and execution across retail account workflows. Support retail promotions, product launches, and other account-specific business initiatives.

· **Warehouse & Logistics Coordination:** Work with warehouses, carriers, freight partners, and internal teams to coordinate inventory availability, inbound and outbound shipments, retail order fulfillment, returns, and transportation issues. Monitor shipment progress and help ensure operational requirements and deadlines are met.

· **Financial Operations Support:** Coordinate routine accounts payable and receivable activities, invoices, payment requests, expense records, and financial documentation. Liaise with external accountants, banks, and financial service providers as needed to support accurate and timely processing.

· **Business & Partner Coordination:** Coordinate with suppliers, service providers, and other external business partners to support daily business operations. Assist with business meetings, trade shows, and industry events as needed.

**What You’ll Bring**

· **Language:** Professional fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English is required.

· **Experience:** 3+ years of experience in retail account operations, business operations, order management, supply chain, logistics coordination, or a related field. Experience supporting major retail accounts such as Costco is strongly preferred.

· **Account & Order Coordination:** Experience managing purchase orders, shipment follow-up, fulfillment documentation, and cross-functional issue resolution.

· **Operational Execution:** Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and follow tasks through to completion.

· **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills with internal teams and external business partners.

· **Financial & Systems Skills:** Comfortable working with invoices, payment documentation, spreadsheets, Microsoft Office, and common business systems.

· **Other Requirements:** Bachelor’s degree required.

**Benefits**

· Health, Dental, and Vision insurance

· Paid time off

· Flexible schedule

· Opportunity to take ownership of key retail account operations in a growing international business

Pay: $32.00 - $36.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance

Language:

* Mandarin (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Family Life Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**SALARY RANGE**

$30 - $32 per hour.

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION**

The Family Life Coordinator keeps the department organized, connected, and moving forward. Working closely with Family Life leadership and program managers, this position coordinates shared priorities, upcoming programs, and operational needs across all Family Life functions. These include Tikvah, Athletics, Youth Recreation, Camp, Dance, Musical Theater, Playdate, Maccabi initiatives, and family events.

The Coordinator gathers information from managers, brings the team together, tracks responsibilities and deadlines, and follows up to ensure plans move into action. The role anticipates needs, identifies gaps, and brings timely updates and requests for decisions to leadership. Program managers retain responsibility for program strategy, budgets, and staff supervision; the Coordinator supports execution and accountability through clear organization and consistent follow-through.

This is a highly collaborative position requiring initiative, sound judgment, and confidence in working with colleagues at different levels. It combines department coordination, hands-on program support, customer service, and routine administration. The position works on-site five days per week and moves regularly between the office and active program spaces.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

##### **Department Coordination and Follow-Through**

* Maintain a shared department calendar and action tracker covering upcoming programs, launches, events, key deadlines, responsible staff, and operational needs.
* Check in regularly with program managers to understand what is coming up, what support is needed, and where plans require coordination across areas.
* Organize and help facilitate Family Life operations meetings; gather agenda items, document decisions and action items, and follow up on commitments.
* Prompt managers and leadership for needed information, approvals, and decisions; provide concise progress updates and flag delays or unresolved issues early.
* Coordinate shared staffing, space, equipment, and communication needs; help resolve scheduling conflicts and bring resource decisions to the appropriate manager.
* Help translate agreed priorities into practical next steps and coordinate with Facilities, Marketing, Account Services, and other internal partners to move work forward.

##### **Program Readiness and Operations**

* Coordinate operational preparation for Tikvah, Athletics, Youth Recreation, Camp, and other Family Life programs, including schedules, space reservations, staffing logistics, supplies, and equipment.
* Use practical readiness checklists to confirm that rosters, participant information, materials, family communications, and staff instructions are available before programs begin.
* Ensure coaches, instructors, seasonal staff, and other program team members receive timely schedules, updates, and the resources needed to deliver programs.
* Coordinate training logistics and help managers arrange coverage for open shifts, breaks, or absences; communicate coverage gaps promptly.

##### **Hands-On Program Support**

* Provide an active on-site presence during programs and events, supporting check-in and check-out, attendance, participant transitions, setup, breakdown, and family questions.
* Step into program activities or temporary coverage as needed, including recreation, athletics, camp, and customer service duties appropriate to training and experience.
* Support Tikvah activities and participants under the direction of program leadership, following individual support guidance and established inclusion and safety practices.
* Observe program flow, respond to routine operational needs, and alert managers to concerns affecting safety, staffing, or participant experience.

##### **Family Experience and Administrative Support**

* Provide welcoming, responsive service to families and maintain a working knowledge of Family Life programs, schedules, and participation options.
* Coordinate approved program reminders and updates, and route participant concerns or questions requiring a decision to the appropriate manager.
* Partner with the Family Life Administrator and Program Managers on registrations, transfers, refunds, waitlists, rosters, and participant records; assist with routine tasks as needed using established procedures.
* Use basic Salesforce and other department tools to update records, access routine reports, and track program readiness and operational needs.
* Maintain organized attendance records, forms, waivers, and other required documentation, protecting confidential participant and family information.
* Follow established departmental procedures and complete other related duties as assigned.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* BA or BS degree required, or equivalent combination of experience and education.
* At least 2 years of experience in youth programing.
* Salesforce experience a plus.
* Outstanding customer service skills and experience working in a customer-centric organization.
* Experience and ability in designing, creating managing and implementing schedules, reports, and operational plans.
* Outstanding computer skills, including advanced skills in MS Office and the ability to learn new business software programs.
* Experience working with children age 3-13 Working knowledge of child development is a plus.
* Previous experience working in an athletics/ recreation/camp background, specifically within program facilitation and support.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Must be well-organized with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work as part of a team and effectively engage and coordinate with various stakeholders (both staff and clients).
* Ability to handle multiple projects, setting appropriate priorities, and effective time management while ensuring that all deadlines are honored.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

As a woman-driven, pediatric therapist-led organization, Ascend is dedicated to making a positive impact in the community. We are excited to announce the upcoming opening of our Union City outpatient clinicnd are seeking a dynamic Administrative Coordinator/Clinic Coordinator to join our expanding team.

jobs.description:
**About Obvio AI**
------------------

Each year, more than 40,000 people in the U.S. leave home and never make it back due to traffic crashes. At Obvio, we believe these deaths are preventable. We deploy solar-powered, AI-assisted cameras to enforce traffic laws where pedestrians are most vulnerable, automating enforcement in ways that traditional systems cannot. Our approach has already led to a 50% reduction in reckless driving in early partner cities.

Founded by the team behind Motive's AI dashcam and backed by Bain Capital Ventures and Khosla Ventures, we are building the intelligence layer for safer streets globally.

### **About the Role**

We are seeking a high-agency, hands-on Events & Field Marketing Manager to build and lead our field presence from the ground up. In this role, you will own how Obvio shows up in the physical world: from public safety trade shows and municipal conferences to intimate roundtables with local officials, police chiefs, city planners, and enterprise partners.

You will bridge offline experiences with sales pipeline, brand building, and community engagement. You will evaluate where Obvio invests, design high-impact activations that stand out, negotiate contracts, and oversee end-to-end technical and physical execution on-site.

### **What You'll Do**

* Lead the strategy, planning, and execution of Obvio’s field marketing calendar, directly aligning event strategy with GTM revenue targets and geographical expansion goals.
* Evaluate, prioritize, and secure Obvio’s presence at major government expos, public safety summits, traffic safety conferences, and industry trade shows.
* Conceptualize and launch proprietary Obvio events, including executive dinners, regional roundtables, live hardware demos, and community launch activations.
* Own end-to-end event production: site selection, booth design, vendor management, hardware demo setups, staffing, travel logistics, and budget allocation.
* Partner with Sales and Government Relations on target account strategy, pre-event outreach, on-site meeting schedules, and post-event lead routing.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to create event-specific toolkits, localized marketing collateral, and interactive hardware demonstrations.
* Establish event KPIs, track lead attribution and deliver clear post-event performance reporting to GTM leadership.
* Build repeatable, scalable field playbooks to support rapid company growth across new markets.
* Identify and secure high-impact speaking opportunities, panels, and media engagements for company executives, building credibility and positioning the company as a recognized authority in the market.
* Plan and coordinate truck-based roadshows showcasing our mobile hardware, managing logistics, routing, venue partnerships, and on-site execution to deliver memorable hands-on experiences for customers and prospects.
* Organize recurring internal events that bring key company leaders together, fostering alignment, collaboration, and connection across teams and functions.

### **What We're Looking For**

* 3-6+ years of experience in field marketing, event operations, or experiential marketing, ideally within B2B SaaS, AI, smart cities, physical hardware, or public sector technology.
* Proven track record of independently planning and executing multi-format events, ranging from multi-thousand-person trade shows to intimate C-level executive dinners.
* High agency, an ownership mindset, and a bias toward action in fast-paced, high-growth startup environments.
* Exceptional project management skills with meticulous attention to detail across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Strong cross-functional alignment skills, with experience preparing executive spokespeople and driving post-event sales follow-through.
* Willingness to travel regularly (up to 30-40%) to direct on-site setup and execution.

### **Bonus Points**

* Direct experience working with municipal governments, public safety agencies, law enforcement, or transportation departments.
* Hands-on experience coordinating physical hardware or complex technical product demos in field/outdoor settings.
* Proficiency with modern GTM and event platforms

jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

 **Requirements**

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: being onsite to set-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem-solve, and ensure high quality set-up and customer experience
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point-of-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
* Facilitate audits of restaurant event set-up to ensure consistency and high quality
* Escalate issues to Operations Manager when necessary to keep them informed or help problem solve
* Critical hours are over lunch we have positions available Monday - Friday (10 am – 2 pm) but responsibilities may span 8am-4pm, depending on the market and need

**Who You Are:**

* You love building relationships with customers and enjoy customer service
* You are friendly, high energy and love interacting with other people
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast-paced start-up
* You are resourceful, exhibit grace under pressure, and know you’re capable of finding solutions
* You are a strong communicator and self-starter
* You are organized and detail oriented. Type-A personality is a plus!
* You’re someone who knows the local territory and gets around efficiently in your own car
* You’re looking for a steady part-time job (between 5 - 25 hours per week) during regular business hours and value flexibility
* Prior catering or serving experience strongly preferred

 **Benefits**

**What We’ll Hook You Up With:**

* Competitive wages: $22-$23/hr based on experience level
* 401k Retirement Savings Plan with company match
* Long-term opportunities for advancement within Fooda
* Networking opportunities for work or career with local restaurants
* A fulfilling, challenging work experience and free food!

Must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No phone calls or recruiters please.

jobs.title: Catering & Event Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Why Work Here?**

Awesome place to work, friendly co-workers, opportunity for growth! At Burma Superstar & B Star we have a passion for food and hospitality!

**Job Details:**

* Job Title: Catering & Event Sales Coordinator.
* Company- Burma Superstar - SF.
* Wage : $25+/hr boe + Bonus.
* Reports to: Director of Finance & Operations.
* Time- Part-time with potential for full-time.

**Job Overview:**  
The Catering & Events Sales Specialist is responsible for assisting with catering, private dining, and event sales and administrative work. This role includes sales outreach, client relationship management, and departmental organization and execution. Success in this role is measured by detailed organization and follow-up, excellent inter-departmental communication, flawless event execution, and client satisfaction.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Respond promptly to inbound inquiries and leads to onboard customers before passing off to the Catering & Event Supervisor.
* Conduct site tours and present the restaurant’s catering and private dining offerings.
* Provide organizational efficiency, while making sure no detail is missed.
* Create customized proposals, quotes, and contracts that align with client needs and restaurant standards.
* Serve as the initial point of contact for clients during the planning process, ensuring all event details are clear.
* Help organize and coordinate event logistics (timelines, menus, floor plans, special requests) with the Catering & Events Supervisor and restaurant operations team.
* Follow up with clients post-event to ensure satisfaction and encourage repeat business.
* Help track and report on sales activity, pipeline status, and event revenue performance.
* Assist in consistently achieve or exceed monthly and quarterly catering and event sales goals.
* Represent the restaurant at networking events, trade shows, and community functions to drive awareness and leads.

**Requirements:**

* Experience working in DTC & B2B sales and/or the catering/private events industry. (Preferred).
* The ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
* The ability to work as part of a team.
* Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
* Exceptional communication and customer service skills.
* Self-Motivated and driven to excel.

**About BSR Group:**

BSR Group is the company behind Burma Superstar and B Star restaurant in the San Francisco Inner Richmond District. It started simply with the idea of making healthy and delicious comfort food inspired by Burma, China, Southeast Asia and our home, California. Over the past 20 years, we have been striving to provide quality food at affordable prices. Together we are on a mission to bridge cultures through food, and we want YOU to join us on our mission!

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Specific information regarding this recruitment process is listed below.**

**Application Opening: Friday**, **October 9th**, 2026  
**Application Deadline: Monday**, **October 19th**, 2026, 11:59 PM P.S.T  
**Salary Range:**$95,082 - $124,358 Annually  
*Recruitment ID: TEX-3374 -169066, RTF0169063 - 01160218*  
  
**Appointment Type:** Temporary-Exempt (TEX), Category 18. This position is excluded by the Charter from the competitive Civil Service examination process and shall serve at the discretion of the Appointing Officer and not exceed 36 months.

San Francisco Public Works (Public Works) has a far-reaching portfolio with a $453 million annual operating budget, an active capital portfolio that exceeds $3 billion and a workforce of 1,700-plus employees. The department operates around the clock, touching every neighborhood in San Francisco. The staff designs and manages the construction of civic buildings and streets; cleans and greens the right of way; maintains civic buildings; manages multi-million-dollar bond programs; trains people for jobs; keeps the right of way free of hazards; paves the roads; repairs bridges and public stairways; expands accessibility; and works at the forefront addressing some of San Francisco’s biggest challenges. With a mission to enhance the quality of life in San Francisco for residents, visitors and business owners, Public Works is committed to providing outstanding public service through an equity lens.

Please visit the “About Us” section of our website at https://www.sfpublicworks.org/about to learn more about the department’s core values, Racial Equity Initiative, leadership team, history, budget and more.

 **Job Description**

**Important and Essential duties:**

*Your duties as a Volunteer/Outreach Coordinator may include, but are not limited to the following:*

* At the Department of Animal Care and Control, plans, directs and oversees the operation of a volunteer program, community affairs, and related public relations/information functions; assesses productivity, sets goals and establishes work-related priorities; recommends and implements policies and procedures for volunteer, community affairs and related public relations/information programs; works with managers to identify needs and opportunities for utilization of volunteers, and ensures that programs address and meet department needs.
* At the Department of Recreation and Park, plans, directs and oversees an area of the department's city-wide volunteer program, such as natural areas, trails, recreational programs, service learning/environmental education and/or parks; assesses productivity, sets goals and establishes work-related priorities; recommends and implements policies and procedures for assigned program; works with managers, staff and coordinators of other volunteer programs to identify needs and opportunities for utilization of volunteers, and to ensure that assigned program addresses and meets department needs: and participates as a team member to support all areas of the volunteer program. The duties include working with youth and adult volunteers in the field.
* Recruits, screens and oversees the training and retention of volunteers; coordinates, schedules, monitors and evaluates their work to assure maximum program coverage and effectiveness; assures that all departmental procedures are followed; handles public inquiries and any problem situations that may arise involving volunteer programs or staff.
* Designs, develops and implements training and orientation classes in a variety of areas including program procedures, applicable laws and departmental policies, techniques for dealing effectively with the public, use of educational and interpretive materials, and other areas specific to department and program mission and goals.
* Establishes and maintains contacts and relationships with schools, community and corporate groups, other City departments, community leaders, and representatives of outside agencies and the media; develops and organizes community and media events, public service announcements, press releases and other publications to promote and publicize department functions and programs.
* Organizes and implements service learning programs, educational workshops, events and presentations to local groups, schools and civic organizations; conducts tours for visiting professionals, the media and members of the public.
* Develops, produces and distributes newsletters, information flyers and other written material, including use of desktop publishing software, and is responsible for updating information on department/program website.
* Maintains schedules, timesheets, files and records for volunteers, including basic database management and development of statistical data; orders and maintains supplies, tools and equipment for program.
* Participates in fund development activities for program/department, such as organizing events, grant writing and development of partnerships with other organizations.

  
**Qualifications**

**Education:**

Possession of a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university; AND

**Experience:**

One year (2000 hours) of experience supervising, coordinating or directing volunteer services and/or community outreach services in an organization which provides services to the public.

Substitution: Additional experience supervising, coordinating or directing volunteer and/or community relations services, as described above, may be substituted for up to two years of the required baccalaureate degree on a year-for-year basis.

**Note: One-year full-time employment is considered equivalent to 2000 hours (2000 hours of qualifying work experience is based on a 40-hour work week). Any overtime hours that you work above forty (40) hours per week are not included in the calculation to determine full-time employment.**

**Verification:**  
Applicants may be required to submit verification of qualifying education

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Sobhani Research Group (PI: Nasim Sobhani) is dedicated to improving the care of pregnant individual and their infants. The bulk of our studies are focused on diabetes in pregnancy and how to optimize the care of pregnant people living with diabetes. Our studies examine how to improve perinatal outcomes for pregnant individuals with type 1 and type 2 diabetes; leverage advanced diabetes technology in the pregnant population; diagnose and manage gestational diabetes; and better support the emotional and behavioral needs of pregnant individuals with diabetes.

The Clinical Research Coordinator will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.

Incumbent’s duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports, including ensuring complete and accurate data capture; attend regular meetings with the PI and/or other members of the study team; coordinate staff work schedules, assist with training of Assistant CRCs, and assist Clinical Research Supervisor and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; support the development and submission of publications, presentations, reports, and other study-related documents; and perform other duties as assigned.

The CRC will assist the Sobhani Research Group with multiple projects. The CRC will design and develop RedCap databases, enroll patients in research studies and complete chart reviews, data collection and data for later data analysis. The CRC will also perform and/or coordinate biospecimen collection with study participants, coordinate with research team staff, perform initial sample processing and stabilization, and ensure transfer of the specimens to partnering research labs as needed. The CRC will work on IRB/CHR applications and submit protocols, regulatory documents, modifications and updates to the CHR for various ongoing studies. The CRC will coordinate with our multidisciplinary team and collaborators across departments within UCSF as well as non-UCSF campuses. This includes outreach and communication with referring healthcare providers and patient support organizations.

A successful candidate will have a desire to work directly with patients; be passionate about supporting research studies that aim to improve our understanding of pregnancy complications; be dedicated to optimizing the care of individuals with medically complex pregnancies; be committed to the development of evidence-based practices. They will be an independent problem-solver with excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills. They will have a high level of professionalism, an exceptional attention to detail, and experience managing multiple projects and timelines simultaneously. This is a great opportunity for an individual who is interested in academic research, medicine, health care, or public health. A two-year commitment is preferred.

**DEPARTMENT INFO:**

The Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology and Reproductive Sciences (Ob, Gyn & RS) is a major academic Department in the School of Medicine, engaged in clinical, research and training activities at the Parnassus, Mount Zion, and Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital campuses, the new Betty Irene Moore Women’s Hospital at Mission Bay, as well as satellite locations throughout the Bay Area, with an annual operating budget of $150 million. The Department has 134 full-time faculty, 117 other academic appointees, 13 post-doctoral fellows, 22 clinical fellows, 32 residents, 138 voluntary clinical faculty and 270 staff.

The mission of the Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences is to improve the lives and health of all women through excellence, innovation and leadership in patient care, scientific discovery, education, advocacy, and diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to providing quality health care services; educating health care providers and investigators; and conducting research to advance knowledge in our field.

Reasonable accommodation(s) to qualified individuals with disabilities are available as part of the application and interview processes. If you would like to request accommodations, please contact the recruiter or hiring manager. If workplace accommodations are needed after a job offer is made, please contact the supervisor and/or Disability Management Services (DMS) at (415) 476-2621 to initiate the interactive process.

  

REQUIRED:

* HS graduation and sufficient experience and demonstrated skills to successfully perform the assigned duties and responsibilities; and/or equivalent experience/training
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal

jobs.title: Network Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Altais:

At Altais, we’re on a mission to improve the healthcare experience for everyone—starting with the people who deliver it. We believe physicians should spend more time with patients and less time on administrative tasks. Through smarter technology, purpose-built tools, and a team-based model of care, we help doctors do what they do best: care for people.

Altais includes a network of physician-led organizations across California, including Brown & Toland Physicians, Altais Medical Group Riverside, and Family Care Specialists. Together, we’re building a stronger, more connected healthcare system.

**About the Role**

**Are you looking to join a fast-growing, dynamic team?**

We’re a collaborative, purpose-driven group that’s passionate about transforming healthcare from the inside out. At Altais, we support one another, adapt quickly, and work with integrity as we build a better experience for physicians and their patients.

The Network Development Coordinator supports the Network Development Manager in executing initiatives related to provider recruitment, onboarding, and engagement across Altais’s Networks of Care (including Brown & Toland Physicians, Altais Care Network, and Family Care Specialist IPA).

This role is responsible for coordinating outreach efforts, supporting onboarding processes, maintaining provider data, and assisting with relationship management activities to ensure a smooth and efficient experience for prospective and newly contracted providers. The Coordinator plays a key role in operational execution, process support, and cross-functional coordination.

**This position is a hybrid opportunity in the region you're assigned to.**

**Candidates considered for this role must live in California with preference to those in Northern California.**

**You will focus on:**

**Provider Recruitment Support:**

Assist in identifying prospective physicians and providers by conducting research, maintaining lead lists, and supporting outreach efforts. Coordinate initial communications and schedule meetings for the Network Development Manager.

**Provider Onboarding Coordination:**

Support the onboarding process for new providers by coordinating documentation, tracking onboarding steps, and partnering with internal teams (e.g., credentialing, contracting) to ensure timely completion of requirements.

**Provider Engagement Support:**

Assist in maintaining relationships with prospective and newly onboarded providers by coordinating follow-ups, responding to basic inquiries, and escalating issues to the Network Development Manager as needed.

**Presentation & Event Coordination:**

Support preparation of presentation materials, proposals, and outreach content. Coordinate logistics for meetings, events, and presentations (in-person and virtual), including scheduling, materials, and follow-up communication.

**Market & Data Support:**

Conduct basic market research and maintain tracking tools related to provider outreach, recruitment pipelines, and network development activities. Compile data and assist in reporting for leadership review.

**Service & Program Knowledge:**

Maintain working knowledge of organizational services and provider offerings to support accurate communication and coordination efforts.

**Cross-Functional Coordination:**

Partner with internal teams (marketing, physician relations, operations) to support outreach campaigns, communications, and onboarding activities. Assist in coordinating provider-facing initiatives such as events, mailings, and meetings.

**Travel Support:**

Participate in occasional local travel within California to support provider meetings, events, or onboarding activities, as needed.

**The Skills, Experience & Education You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Marketing, or related field *(or equivalent experience)*
* 2–4 years of experience in healthcare, provider relations, operations, coordination, or related field
* Experience supporting projects, programs, or operational workflows
* Familiarity with healthcare environments, provider networks, or managed care preferred

**Preferred:**

* Experience working with physicians or provider offices in an administrative or support capacity
* Exposure to onboarding, credentialing, or provider operations processes

The Compensation for this position is **$56,925 - $74,520/year**

In addition, we provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs.

* Excellent medical, vision, and dental coverage
* 401k savings plan with a company match
* Flexible time off and 9 Paid Holidays

**Final salary determination will take into account the candidate’s geographic location, experience, and qualifications.**

**You Share Our Mission & Values:**

We act with empathy and a deep respect for the challenges faced by physicians and their patients. Our work is driven by a genuine commitment to improving lives and ensuring that care is delivered with dignity, understanding, and humanity.

**Community**

We foster a culture of collaboration-with physicians, patients across the healthcare ecosystem, and among our teams. By building strong, trusted relationships, we create a unified community focused on advancing patient care and physician well-being.

We lead with integrity and vision, setting the standard for excellence in physician support and healthcare innovation. Through collaboration and expertise, we empower others to lead, drive change, and shape the future of care.

**Excellence**

We are relentlessly focused, results-driven, and accountable for delivering measurable value to physicians and the patients they serve. Our high standards reflect our commitment to excellence, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
The American Lung Association has an excellent opportunity for a **Development Coordinator.** Working as a member of the **Development** department, you will join an outstanding group of professionals dedicated to our mission: to save lives by improving lung health and preventing lung disease through research, education, and advocacy.

Works together with the Development Team to coordinate the annual San Francisco Fight For Air Climb (FFA Climb). Responsible for achieving revenue goals through participant and team recruitment and relationship building. This position also has responsibility for supporting the Fight For Air Climb in Los Angeles. Plays a key role in the execution of events through the management of volunteers, timeline, logistics, event collateral, and platform management.

**Location:**

The position is located at the American Lung Association’s San Ramon, California office and will be a hybrid of in-person and virtual work.

**Responsibilities:**

* Together with the Development Manager, implement the area development plan through special events and other revenue sources.
* Coordinate planning for fundraising or stewardship events. Recruit, train & supervise event day volunteers. Prepare reports as required. Execute the constituent engagement plan using various electronic systems.
* Work together with members of the events team to meet or exceed annual revenue goals. Participate in the creation, planning and implementation of new and existing projects.
* Coordinate and oversee event logistics: develop and monitor event project timelines and implementation. Negotiate with vendors to achieve favorable prices that ensure adherence to established budget. Prepare and monitor ongoing event progress reports.
* Recruit, coordinate and coach community event team captains and volunteers. Cultivate relationships and effectively engage volunteers. Work with the Development Team to increase event participation and revenue. Serve as liaison for customer service and troubleshooting for signature events and internal kickoffs.
* Serve as location lead for the development of event websites and content updates, utilizing ALA best practices, software and guidelines.
* Coordinate the implementation of e-communications, mailings and donor acknowledgements.
* Work with the Marketing and Communications department to create and disseminate special events promotional materials.
* Oversee the utilization of ALA databases and e-commerce platforms, Donor Drive & ROI, serves as special events lead on ROI.
* Complete special projects as assigned by the Development Manager or Executive Director.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Nonprofit Management or a related field is preferred; equivalent combinations of education and relevant work experience will also be considered.
* One or two years of fundraising experience preferred with experience recruiting and coordinating volunteers.
* Superb organizational and time management skills with excellent attention to detail and independent follow-through in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong computer skills with website communication, social media and database systems.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* A team player with a positive attitude; comfortable working with all levels of staff
* Must have a valid Driver’s license and your own reliable transportation with the ability to travel within assigned area 30% of the time for meetings and conferences, as well as the flexibility to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends with some overnights required
* Ability to lift and carry 25 lbs. (event supplies)
* Consistent with its mission, the American Lung Association maintains a smoke-free workplace; all employees must abstain from tobacco use in any form, including vaping.

**Compensation:** Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. The target hiring range for this position is between $46,800 and $54,000 per annum.

**Benefits**: The Lung Association offers a comprehensive benefits package including:

* Paid Leave - 10 vacation days in the first year (15 days thereafter), 2 personal days and 15 sick days per year, as well as 12 company-paid holidays per year. We also offer Paid Parental Leave for eligible employees.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Opportunity**

GPJ is hiring an Account Manager to join our growing team.

This role is hybrid, requiring you to report on-site to one of the following office locations a minimum of 2 days/week: Austin, Boston, Detroit, Los Angeles, Nashville, New York City, or San Francisco.

**Your Role**

You are responsible for making sure that projects within your area of responsibility meet their timelines and budget requirements. Your focus is on a smaller scope, but you take this accountability seriously. You also have the task of keeping margin levels in check for the portfolio you've been assigned. This includes managing any service changes that may come up.

Maintaining a strong strategic responsibility and owning client relationships is a key part of your role. You work to build trust and engagement with both your clients and vendors, internal stakeholders, team members, and other departments. You view things through the client lens.

In addition, you support program direction, objectives, and plans. You possess proficiency in our tools (CRM, Deltek, etc) as well as thorough understanding of our processes. You provide a high level of client service and satisfaction, all while ensuring that you consistently and efficiently deploy GPJ methodologies.

Another aspect of your role is to negotiate and collaborate effectively with internal staff. This collaboration is crucial in driving client success and ensuring account profitability. You actively engage with the greater Account Management Practice, including bi-monthly calls, and Slack channel discussions.

Lastly, you may have the opportunity to mentor, manage, lead and develop members of the account team. It's important to support the growth and development of your colleagues in this dynamic role.

**Your Skills**

* Experience working with Fortune 500 brands desired
* Experience working on more than one area of the client program desired
* Experience with increasingly complex projects and events
* Understands how to effectively oversee overall project timelines
* Understands effective budget oversight and troubleshooting for larger budgets, leveraging SMEs as needed
building their 'influence'* - learning how to convey key messages both to the client and within the GPJ/PWW alliance.
* Helps ensure team proactively addresses key project financial metrics, including profitability and margin
* Mindful of overall account health. Helps ensure team interprets and proactively addresses impact of changes on project financial metrics
* Able to have more complex financial conversations with clients.
* Has clear understanding of PO process; able to oversee reconciliation and client invoicing
* Exhibit some understanding of multi-channel marketing (including digitally integrated event and experiential marketing) concepts, terminology, strategies, brand management best practices, and marketplace execution of concepts
* May have direct reports
* May help mentor / teach others on Account team; may help manage onsite resources
* Actively support (or may lead for smaller account) definition of strategic direction for account/program; proactively engage with team to add strategic and creative contributions.
* Lead internal strategic meetings and may present findings to client
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office software including PPT, Word, Excel, Outlook. Previous experience with ERP, Project Management software, or similar tool is preferred

**Your Competencies**

**Account Development & Growth:** Through in-depth business, industry and client knowledge, drive forward thinking approaches and concepts aligned to and anticipating client's needs and objectives enabling agency differentiation, identification of new areas for growth and client satisfaction.

**Client Orientation:** You demonstrate concern for satisfying external and/or internal clients aka client obsession. You focus always on the end clients, ensuring that response times and service are at the forefront of customer interactions, via technology or human touch points. You provide superior client service by prioritizing personal interactions (verbal or face-to-face) with our clients on a regular cadence. You listen as well as advise our clients on given situations to ensure engagement success.

**Relationship Builder:** Develop, maintain and strengthen partnerships with others inside and outside the client organization. Identify new stakeholders, manage client expectations, define new business opportunities and deliver against clients' needs while skillfully balancing the needs of the client and those of the agency. Relates well to all kinds of people, up, down, and sideways, inside and outside the organization; builds appropriate rapport,: builds constructive and effective relationships; uses diplomacy and tact; can diffuse even high-tension situations comfortably.

**Your Experience**

**Experience & Education**

* 5-7 years of previous industry / agency experience
* 2(+) years of client management experience desired
* 4 Year College Degree; preferred in Marketing/Advertising/Event Management/Business Administration, Hospitality, Communications, or related field

**Travel & Mobility**

* Ability to travel as required
* Ability to work irregular hours in addition to normal business hours, to include nights, weekends and holidays as needed

**Your Impact**

In your role, you will have influence and responsibility over:

* Business Development
* Project Launch
* Management, Delivery & Deployment
* Change Order Management
* Invoicing, Financial Reconciliation & Closing

**Salary Range: $65k - $75k**

Do you enjoy customer service and building meaningful connections? Are you self-driven and find excitement in sales activities?

As a **Service Account Manager**, you will have the opportunity to actively seek out, manage, and nurture a portfolio of key accounts within the mechanical contracting industry. Your primary responsibility is to provide exceptional customer service while fostering strong relationships with both new and existing clients. The Service Account Manager will use their expertise and industry knowledge to navigate customers through the sales process and ensure satisfaction with our products and services.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Develop and manage a portfolio of key accounts in the mechanical industry specializing in service agreements, repairs and projects.
* Drive client engagement and satisfaction by evaluating operations through on-site inspections and offer expert HVAC, plumbing and piping solutions that are tailored to client’s needs.
* Proactively generate new business through prospecting, cold calling, emails, and onsite meetings with prospective clients.
* Identify growth potential with existing accounts, analyzing performance, and developing strategies to enhance client satisfaction, retention, and revenue.
* Build and manage a robust sales pipeline, tracking customer interactions, forecasts, and presenting updates during monthly meetings.
* Create detailed proposals for new and existing clients, outlining scopes of work tailored to their unique requirements.
* Follow up with submitted customer proposals on a weekly basis, maintaining communication to address inquiries or modifications.
* Tracks annual contract renewals, engaging with clients prior to expiration for repeat business.
* Identify and pursue cross-selling opportunities for Plumbing services by collaborating with internal partners to deliver comprehensive service offerings.
* Maintain a competitive edge by staying abreast of market trends, emerging technologies, and industry advancements within the assigned region.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery and act as a liaison between clients and various departments within SVM.

**EDUCATION, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* 2+ years’ experience as a HVAC Account Manager or Sales Representative **required**.
* 2+ years’ experience working with a Mechanical Contractor or related field **required**.
* High school diploma or general education degree (GED; or equivalent combination of education and experience) **required.**
* Proficient knowledge of HVAC systems and terminology utilized in the Mechanical Industry **required.**
* Proven experience successfully establishing and managing a book of business **required.**
* Demonstrates strong technical aptitude with experience writing grammatically correct customer proposals **required.**
* Proven ability to overcome objections and challenges with customers **required.**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to maintain strong relationships **required.**
* Highly proficient with various office equipment and programs including MS Office Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel), Accounting Software or a CRM **required.**
* Possesses a valid California’s Driver’s License and willing to submit to a DMV report **a must.**

**COMPENSATION & COMPANY BENEFITS INCLUDE**

This is a full-time exempt position. The compensation for this role is $100,000- $170,000 annually and is based on experience and skillset.

**Health:** Medical / Dental / Vision / Life & Disability Insurance / FSA

**Financial Wellness**: Deferred Compensation Plan / 401k w/ Employer Contribution / Employee Referral Bonus / “Positive Pulse”

**Community Investment**: Volunteer Opportunities / Team Building Activities / Employee Activities

Cyberhaven is looking for a Manager, Technical Account Management to build and lead the team of Technical Account Managers who own the technical relationship with our customers. Your team is accountable for how each customer deploys, adopts, and gets value from Cyberhaven's Agentic Data Security platform, from onboarding through renewal. You will hire and develop the team, define how TAMs work with accounts, and make sure customers get a consistent, proactive technical partner and experience.

You are a people leader with a technical background in security SaaS and endpoint agents, and you are comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where the team's processes are still being written. You will coach TAMs on and step in on critical escalations when needed. You will also work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support Engineering, Customer Experience, and Sales to turn what the team learns from customers into improvements to the product and to how we serve customers.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience leading customer-facing technical teams are required. You will report to the VP of Support and Technical Account Management.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead and grow the team**

* Hire, onboard, and develop Technical Account Managers. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback, and run career development and performance reviews.
* Coach TAMs on account strategy, technical troubleshooting, executive communication, and managing difficult customer situations.
* Build a team culture of growth mindset, ownership, curiosity, and accountability for customer outcomes.
* Plan headcount and coverage as the customer base grows, including how accounts are assigned and balanced across the team.

### **Define how the TAM function operates**

* Establish the TAM operating model: account segmentation, coverage, engagement cadence, business review format, and technical success plans.
* Set the team's goals and metrics, such as account health, agent coverage and deployment progress, adoption, escalation volume and time to resolution, and customer satisfaction. Report on them to leadership.
* Create and maintain playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge base standards so TAMs handle common situations the same way.
* Define the handoffs between TAMs and Customer Experience and Sales so customers always know who owns what.

### **Own customer outcomes**

* Review account health across the team's book of business and step in early on accounts at risk of low adoption, deployment problems, or churn.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues. Make sure TAMs bring clear reproductions and context to Engineering, and that customers stay informed through resolution.
* Build relationships with customes, and join executive and business reviews for strategic accounts.
* Work with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.

### **Be the voice of the customer**

* Collect customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring issues from the team and bring them to Product Management and Engineering with the technical and business context behind them.
* Work with Engineering and Support Engineering to improve diagnostics, debugging tools, and escalation processes.
* Run root cause analysis reviews on significant incidents and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.
* Stay current on industry trends, security best practices, and adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA, and bring them into the team's guidance to customers.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 3+ years of experience managing a team of Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, Solutions Engineers, or similar customer-facing technical staff.
* 7+ years in customer-facing technical roles.
* Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong technical people, and of handling performance issues directly and fairly.
* Experience building or scaling a TAM, Support, or Customer Success function, including processes, playbooks, and metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience managing escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, set timelines, and track progress across a team and its accounts.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, enterprise network infrastructure, and Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint management (SCCM, GPO, Intune, MDM, and application management).
* Ability to read and interpret logs and diagnostic output across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine well enough to coach others and guide technical investigations.

### **Desired**

* Familiarity with adjacent technologies that Cyberhaven integrates with (SIEM, SOAR, UEBA).
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.
* Prior experience leading a TAM team at a security or SaaS company.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth company where the team's processes were still being defined.
* Background in L2/L3 or Escalation Engineering for EDR or DLP tools.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

jobs.description:
**Customer Success Lead**

Hybrid (San Francisco, CA) Full-time

**About Alethios**

Alethios is a decentralized health research platform. We give researchers one place to build a protocol, manage participants, and integrate wearables and surveys, in real-time, so they can go from formulation to validation without the friction of traditional, site-based research. We're a mission-driven company, focused on lowering the barriers to human health research for both researchers and participants. And we're growing quickly: more studies, more researchers, more categories, every month.

We're looking for someone who cares about human health, sweats the details, builds things, and wants to be at a mission-driven company. This is the first hire in this function. You'll define what customer success means at Alethios, reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with Business Operations and Engineering.

**The role**

You'll own customer success end to end: study startup, go-live, and study ops. Day-to-day, that means working directly with researchers and sponsors to get their studies launched and run well.

The bigger opportunity is what you build while doing it. We launch 5 to 10 studies a month and that number is growing fast. The tools you create, such as automated study-health monitoring, templated onboarding, or AI-assisted client reporting, are what will take it substantially higher without growing the team. The best people here make themselves more leveraged every month, and this role is designed for that.

The work comes down to four things: relationship management, tool building, excellent follow-through, and both an instinct and an analytic approach for what makes a great study.

**What you'll do**

* Run study kickoff and onboarding: offer input on protocol digitization and study decentralization
* Monitor study health: enrollment pacing, participant compliance, data flow from surveys and wearables
* Own the client communication cadence: status updates, mid-study check-ins, results walkthroughs. Build the systems that generate these updates
* Coordinate with our distribution team on kit timing, client product receipt, and participant mailing
* Drive renewals and expansion: a great first study should become a second
* Build the machine: automated study-health dashboards, templated onboarding flows, self-serve client resources, AI-assisted reporting
* Be the voice of the customer to engineering: feed pain points and patterns back into the product roadmap

**Who you are**

* You're product-minded: you've built workflows, automations, or internal tools, and you reach for AI tooling by default
* You're health-focused, with either a serious hunger to learn and analyze data or a clinical/research background
* You prepare for every meeting: clients notice, and so do we
* You're organized under pressure: multiple concurrent studies won't rattle you
* You're creative: when the obvious process doesn't fit, you invent one that does

**Nice to have**

* Clinical credentials or a health sciences background
* Experience at an early-stage company where you built the function rather than inherited it
* Familiarity with HubSpot, Intercom, or IRB submission tools

**Benefits**

We want our team to feel supported, in work and in life. Alethios offers:

* **Competitive compensation** including equity that reflects the value and impact you bring from day one
* **Health benefits**: we cover 100% of healthcare and dental plan premiums for employees
* **Generous PTO** so you can recharge fully and show up at your best
* **Mission-driven work** that directly lowers barriers to evidence generation and makes research more accessible
* **A dynamic team**: small and collaborative, where every voice matters and cross-disciplinary thinking shapes the product daily
* **SF office with flexibility**: this role is hybrid out of our San Francisco office

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94104

jobs.title: Inventory & Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are hiring a junior Inventory & Logistics Coordinator in Fremont, CA to maintain accurate inventory, organize stock, coordinate inbound and outbound product movement, and support international and RMA shipments. We design, build, and assemble our devices in-house. This position serves as the operational link between physical inventory, logistics, and the Purchasing department.

The primary focus is inventory control, stock management, and logistics execution. Purchasing is a collaborative support function: this role will communicate stock levels, reorder needs, shipment status, receiving discrepancies, and demand information so Purchasing can make timely buying decisions and prevent stockouts or excess inventory.

**Primary Responsibilities**

*Inventory Control & Stock Management*

* Maintain accurate inventory records in the inventory and ERP platform, ensuring system quantities align with physical stock.
* Count, verify, and document incoming materials, finished products, outgoing shipments, returns, and replacement units.
* Perform routine cycle counts and periodic physical inventory checks; investigate and resolve discrepancies, missing items, and transaction errors.
* Receive parts and materials, complete quality checks for damage or defects, and document vendor or shipment issues.
* Label, organize, and store inventory with clear item identification, location control, and separation of new and existing stock.
* Maintain minimum and safety-stock thresholds for parts, consumables, finished products, repair supplies, and replacement materials.
* Monitor inventory usage and stock movement to identify low-stock, slow-moving, or excess items and recommend appropriate action.
* Organize and maintain both the in-house storage area and offsite storage facility for efficient retrieval and accurate stock visibility.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly inventory reports for Finance and provide inventory status updates to Operations and Purchasing.

*Logistics, Shipping & Receiving*

* Coordinate domestic and international inbound and outbound shipments, including seasonal increases during Q2 and Q4.
* Prepare commercial invoices, packing lists, Certificates of Origin, and other required customs documentation.
* Assign appropriate Harmonized System (HS) codes and support accurate duty, tax, tariff, and landed-cost calculations.
* Coordinate with FedEx, DHL, UPS, USPS, and ShipStation to schedule, track, and troubleshoot shipments.
* Apply Incoterms and destination-country requirements to support compliant international delivery.
* Monitor shipment status, delivery timing, damages, shortages, and carrier exceptions; communicate delays and resolve issues promptly.
* Coordinate RMA repair and replacement shipments, ensuring stock records, customs documents, and delivery details are accurate.
* Package and ship individual devices and kits and, when required, deliver packages to local carrier locations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce freight and total landed costs while maintaining service and compliance.

*Purchasing Department Collaboration*

* Provide Purchasing with accurate stock balances, reorder-point alerts, open shipment status, and anticipated material needs.
* Collaborate with Purchasing to convert approved replenishment needs into timely purchase orders and follow through on delivery status.
* Support material requirements planning (MRP) by sharing inventory usage, stock availability, lead-time concerns, and demand information.
* Track purchase orders in the ERP system and coordinate expediting when materials are at risk of stockout or production delay.
* Reconcile received quantities against purchase orders and packing documents; communicate shortages, overages, damages, and invoice discrepancies.
* Partner with Purchasing and Engineering on occasional sourcing needs, vendor information, and part substitutions.
* Support supplier performance tracking by documenting on-time delivery, quality issues, and recurring receiving discrepancies.
* Coordinate with Purchasing, Finance, Sales, Operations, and warehouse stakeholders to align material availability with business priorities.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 1+ years of experience in inventory control, stock management, logistics, shipping and receiving, or supply chain operations; 2-3+ years of combined inventory and logistics experience is strongly preferred.
* Hands-on experience maintaining inventory accuracy, managing stock locations, completing counts, and resolving discrepancies.
* Understanding of purchasing workflows, purchase orders, reorder points, lead times, and supplier coordination.
* International shipping or customs documentation experience is preferred.
* Manufacturing operations exposure is a plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required, along with comfort using Microsoft Office 365.
* Experience with ERP or inventory management systems; Confluence, ShipStation, and FedEx tools are a plus.
* Strong attention to detail, math, organization, documentation, and record-keeping skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and communicate clearly across Purchasing, Operations, Finance, and Engineering.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs; most individual shipments weigh approximately 5-10 lbs.
* Reliable transportation for occasional package drop-offs at USPS, FedEx, or UPS locations.
* Able to work in-office Monday-Friday in Fremont, CA.

Pay: $20.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

For over 20 years, 4LEAF has assisted communities in successfully navigating contract services, leading to fiscally responsible solutions. As one of the industry’s notable providers of planning, building and safety, construction management, and fire consulting services, 4LEAF has an enviable track record of completing complex projects and staffing assignments with both public and private clients. The dedication of our staff combined with our company culture, have consistently allowed us to meet and exceed the needs of our clients.

The Marketing Assistant / Proposal Writer will support proposal development, marketing content management, and related marketing initiatives. The ideal candidate is resourceful, proactive, highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable working with project managers, directors, subject matter experts, and marketing team members to produce accurate, polished, and timely materials.

**Content and Data Management:**

* Create and maintain reusable proposal content, including resumes, project descriptions, client data, photos, graphics, and value messaging.
* Support fact-checking, version control, and quality control of marketing content and templates (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, InDesign).
* Maintain digital assets, marketing data, and internal content libraries.

**Marketing Support:**

* Assist in developing marketing communications across print, web, email, social media, and presentations.
* Attend conferences and events to represent 4LEAF, support logistics, and promote services.
* Develop a strong understanding of 4LEAF's service lines — including planning, building and safety, engineering, construction management, inspection, code enforcement, and fire consulting — to produce accurate, compelling content.
* Coordinate events, sponsorships, and promotional materials.
* Maintain marketing tracking systems, collateral inventory, and promotional items.
* Conduct competitive research and other marketing support as directed.

* Bachelor's degree in English, Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or related field preferred.

* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and content organization skills with a creative and persuasive voice.
* Solid project management skills — organized, self-directed, able to multi-task and meet deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal skills; able to collaborate effectively with internal teams and subject matter experts.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher, Outlook), including advanced formatting, templates, and styles.
* Knowledge of visual design principles; Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) preferred.
* Experience with digital asset management, CRM, or marketing databases a plus.

Northern New Jersey | Hybrid Position | Headzup Inc

Help move projects from paperwork to completion.

We’re looking for an organized, proactive person who enjoys keeping things moving, solving problems, and following through. This position combines practical project coordination with permit expediting—helping projects work through municipal approvals and stay on track through completion.

Already have experience with permits or project management? Great. Have strong organizational skills and a willingness to learn? We’d like to hear from you, too.

What you’ll do

 Prepare, submit, and track permit applications with guidance from our team.

 Communicate with municipal building departments about requirements, application status, and next steps.

 Keep project documents, approvals, and updates organized and accessible.

 Help coordinate inspections and project closeout.

 Spot potential delays early and help resolve them.

What we’re looking for

 Strong organization, attention to detail, and dependable follow-through.

 Clear, professional communication by phone, email, and in person.

 Ability to manage several projects and changing priorities.

 Comfort with email, spreadsheets, and learning project management software.

 A practical approach to problem-solving and the confidence to ask questions.

 Experience in project coordination, construction administration, or permit expediting is a plus.

 Willingness to learn municipal permitting processes throughout New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and upstate New York.

 Must have a reliable vehicle and be willing to drive to municipal offices throughout New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and upstate New York. Mileage reimbursement is provided.

Prior experience in project management or permit expediting is preferred but not required. We welcome candidates with strong organizational skills, a proactive approach, and a willingness to learn.

jobs.description:
**About Alliance Transfer**

Alliance Transfer has handled commercial relocations, furniture delivery and installation, warehousing and office decommissioning in the New York metro area since 1986. We run our own trucks and crews out of a Newark warehouse and work in occupied Manhattan office buildings for law firms, financial firms, hospitals, universities and furniture dealers. We are family-owned, non-union, and small enough that good people get noticed fast. Our office admin started in a support seat and now runs our books.

**The job**

You keep every job on the calendar complete and every hour accounted for. Between the time a proposal is signed and the time the invoice goes out, you are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks: the calendar event has the right address, contact, crew count and equipment; the building has our COI; the client has a confirmation; the crew has a bill of lading; and the time sheets match what actually happened.

This is a seat for someone who wants to learn the business from the inside. If you grow into scoping and running jobs, there is a Project Manager path here.

**What you will do**

* Own the Job Schedule calendar: enter every booked job with client, address, contacts, scope, crew count, trucks and equipment
* Build and send bills of lading, crew call sheets and client confirmations before each job
* Collect and reconcile daily time sheets against the schedule; flag gaps and overtime before payroll
* Request and track certificates of insurance, elevator reservations and dock windows with building management
* Keep job folders current: proposals, estimates, floor plans, photos, sign-offs, damage reports
* Be the first-line contact for clients on logistics questions once a job is booked
* Track scope changes and open items on live jobs so nothing is missed at billing
* Support the Operations Manager and Project Manager with proposal prep, site walk notes and meeting follow-ups
* Help with field recruiting paperwork: onboarding, certifications, availability

**What we are looking for**

* 2+ years in a coordinator, scheduler, office or admin role at a moving, logistics, construction, facilities or furniture company
* Detail obsessed; you notice a wrong suite number before anyone else does
* Fast and tidy in Google Workspace (Calendar, Sheets, Docs) and comfortable learning QuickBooks, CompanyCam and HubSpot
* Writes a clean, short email
* Calm on the phone with clients, building staff and crew
* Nice to have: experience with COIs and building logistics in Manhattan, Spanish, interest in moving into project management

**Pay and benefits**

* $52,000 to $65,000 a year, based on experience
* Health and dental insurance
* Paid time off and holidays
* Hybrid after six months
* A real path to Project Manager for the right person

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with a resume. Tell us about a time you caught a mistake before it cost somebody money.

Pay: $52,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
