jobs.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About City Winery**

Imagine a sold-out show, a glass of wine made on-site, and a great dinner, all under one roof. That's City Winery. Every year we produce thousands of concerts and hundreds of wines across ten live entertainment venues in nine metropolitan areas. Each venue is also a working winery and restaurant. We also run five standalone restaurants and winegardens.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Digital Marketing Coordinator to join our digital marketing team and help fill the room, night after night. Reporting to our Digital Marketing Manager, you'll build, launch, and optimize paid social and programmatic campaigns that turn a scroll into a ticket sale, and you'll see the results of your work in real time as shows sell out.

This is an entry-level role built for learning. From day one you'll manage live campaigns on the major ad platforms, work with real budgets, and learn performance marketing fundamentals from an experienced team. Because the team is small, your ideas and your work will be seen and will make a real difference. If you love digital marketing and want to start your career in live music, food, and wine, we'd love to meet you.  
  
 **What You'll Do**

* Build and launch digital ad campaigns for shows at City Winery venues on platforms including Meta, Google, TikTok, StackAdapt, Vibe, and LinkedIn.
* Monitor and optimize ad spend, CPA, and ROAS so every dollar works as hard as possible.
* Write and refresh ad copy that matches the City Winery brand voice, priority keywords, and website messaging.
* Test new ideas across creative, audiences, and targeting, measure what works, and share what you learn with the team.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports and turn the numbers into clear takeaways.
* Work with local marketing teams at each venue so campaigns support their show calendars and overall strategy.
* Help track progress against annual paid media goals.
* Implement AI Search and SEO tactics that improve search performance, including maintaining search listings and updating website content.
* Support other digital marketing priorities such as email, and SMS as needed.
* Keep up with digital advertising trends and bring new ideas to the table.

  
**What You'll Learn**  

* How to plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across multiple paid social and programmatic platforms
* How to read performance data and connect ad spend to ticket sales
* How live events are marketed, from announcement to on-sale to sold out
* How AI tools can speed up campaign creation, testing, and reporting
* How a small, fast-moving digital team works across ecommerce, venues, and brand

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree required; a degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or a related field is preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the curiosity to ask questions when something isn't clear
* A basic understanding of digital marketing concepts. Coursework, internships, and personal projects all count.
* Comfort with Google Workspace, especially spreadsheets
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines on your own
* A tech-savvy mindset and interest in how AI tools can make marketing smarter and faster
* A genuine passion for music, food, wine, and live entertainment
* Based in New York City, with potential, occasional travel to other City Winery locations

**Bonus Points**

* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, StackAdapt, Vibe, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4) or other analytics tools
* Experience managing local listings

**About Us**

Wine, food, and live entertainment collide at City Winery to create a dynamic and incredibly unique workplace. Since 2008, City Winery has been turning heads across the nation with amazing live performances, delectable cuisine, and award winning, locally produced wines. But there's more to us than that we're a haven for community and creativity, a place where the philosophy of hospitality is more than just a buzzword, but a way of life. City Winery, founded by music industry veteran & visionary Michael Dorf, has established itself as a one-of-a-kind brand providing unforgettable experiences for guests. From world class music venues to sustainably produced wines with ratings of 90+ points, City Winery offers a range of topnotch events & experiences.

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at City Winery. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Additionally, City Winery participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.**

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Opportunity**

GPJ is hiring an Account Manager to join our growing team.

This role is hybrid, requiring you to report on-site to one of the following office locations a minimum of 2 days/week: Austin, Boston, Detroit, Los Angeles, Nashville, New York City, or San Francisco.

**Your Role**

You are responsible for making sure that projects within your area of responsibility meet their timelines and budget requirements. Your focus is on a smaller scope, but you take this accountability seriously. You also have the task of keeping margin levels in check for the portfolio you've been assigned. This includes managing any service changes that may come up.

Maintaining a strong strategic responsibility and owning client relationships is a key part of your role. You work to build trust and engagement with both your clients and vendors, internal stakeholders, team members, and other departments. You view things through the client lens.

In addition, you support program direction, objectives, and plans. You possess proficiency in our tools (CRM, Deltek, etc) as well as thorough understanding of our processes. You provide a high level of client service and satisfaction, all while ensuring that you consistently and efficiently deploy GPJ methodologies.

Another aspect of your role is to negotiate and collaborate effectively with internal staff. This collaboration is crucial in driving client success and ensuring account profitability. You actively engage with the greater Account Management Practice, including bi-monthly calls, and Slack channel discussions.

Lastly, you may have the opportunity to mentor, manage, lead and develop members of the account team. It's important to support the growth and development of your colleagues in this dynamic role.

**Your Skills**

* Experience working with Fortune 500 brands desired
* Experience working on more than one area of the client program desired
* Experience with increasingly complex projects and events
* Understands how to effectively oversee overall project timelines
* Understands effective budget oversight and troubleshooting for larger budgets, leveraging SMEs as needed
building their 'influence'* - learning how to convey key messages both to the client and within the GPJ/PWW alliance.
* Helps ensure team proactively addresses key project financial metrics, including profitability and margin
* Mindful of overall account health. Helps ensure team interprets and proactively addresses impact of changes on project financial metrics
* Able to have more complex financial conversations with clients.
* Has clear understanding of PO process; able to oversee reconciliation and client invoicing
* Exhibit some understanding of multi-channel marketing (including digitally integrated event and experiential marketing) concepts, terminology, strategies, brand management best practices, and marketplace execution of concepts
* May have direct reports
* May help mentor / teach others on Account team; may help manage onsite resources
* Actively support (or may lead for smaller account) definition of strategic direction for account/program; proactively engage with team to add strategic and creative contributions.
* Lead internal strategic meetings and may present findings to client
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office software including PPT, Word, Excel, Outlook. Previous experience with ERP, Project Management software, or similar tool is preferred

**Your Competencies**

**Account Development & Growth:** Through in-depth business, industry and client knowledge, drive forward thinking approaches and concepts aligned to and anticipating client's needs and objectives enabling agency differentiation, identification of new areas for growth and client satisfaction.

**Client Orientation:** You demonstrate concern for satisfying external and/or internal clients aka client obsession. You focus always on the end clients, ensuring that response times and service are at the forefront of customer interactions, via technology or human touch points. You provide superior client service by prioritizing personal interactions (verbal or face-to-face) with our clients on a regular cadence. You listen as well as advise our clients on given situations to ensure engagement success.

**Relationship Builder:** Develop, maintain and strengthen partnerships with others inside and outside the client organization. Identify new stakeholders, manage client expectations, define new business opportunities and deliver against clients' needs while skillfully balancing the needs of the client and those of the agency. Relates well to all kinds of people, up, down, and sideways, inside and outside the organization; builds appropriate rapport,: builds constructive and effective relationships; uses diplomacy and tact; can diffuse even high-tension situations comfortably.

**Your Experience**

**Experience & Education**

* 5-7 years of previous industry / agency experience
* 2(+) years of client management experience desired
* 4 Year College Degree; preferred in Marketing/Advertising/Event Management/Business Administration, Hospitality, Communications, or related field

**Travel & Mobility**

* Ability to travel as required
* Ability to work irregular hours in addition to normal business hours, to include nights, weekends and holidays as needed

**Your Impact**

In your role, you will have influence and responsibility over:

* Business Development
* Project Launch
* Management, Delivery & Deployment
* Change Order Management
* Invoicing, Financial Reconciliation & Closing

**Salary Range: $65k - $75k**

*Salary is dependent on a variety of factors including (but not limited to) experience, skills, and location.*

**Who We Are**

GPJ is the world leader in experiential marketing. Our 29 global offices are filled with fearless people dreaming up ideas that are transforming industries and bringing the most respected brands to life in powerfully, exciting ways. We are a part of the Project Worldwid

jobs.title: Ecommerce Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About RugsUSA**

Founded in 1998, Rugs USA has grown into a trusted online destination for high-quality rugs that bring style and value to every space. Today, we have a growing portfolio of home and lifestyle brands, all with a shared commitment to making it easier for people to create spaces they love. Our portfolio includes Annie Selke, known for thoughtfully designed home goods rooted in quality craftsmanship; and nuLOOM, which makes design-forward rugs accessible at a range of price points.

We’re passionate about the difference the right pieces can make in a space, so we’ve built close relationships with designers, artisans, and factories around the world. Those partnerships help us keep our model simple, offer great value, and bring customers a wide range of styles.

Whether someone is refreshing a room or starting from scratch, we want the process to feel easy and inspiring. Our curated assortment gives customers the pieces they need to bring their vision for home to life, whatever their style or price point.

**Position Overview**

The Ecommerce Account Manager is responsible for managing the day-to-day activities, support needs, and growth opportunities for a portfolio of wholesale and marketplace ecommerce accounts. This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned web-based customers, ensuring they have accurate product information, pricing, imagery, specifications, and the tools needed to successfully market and sell our products online.

The Ecommerce Account Manager will work closely with customers, Codarus representatives, and the Annie Selke Inside Sales Representative team to provide timely information, resolve issues, support account growth, and deliver reporting and insights that drive business results.

**Essential Job Functions**

Manage the daily operational needs of multiple wholesale and marketplace ecommerce accounts.

* Serve as the primary contact for customers and reps regarding product information, pricing, promotional calendar, imagery, specifications, inventory inquiries, and account support.
* Respond promptly to customer questions and requests, coordinating with internal teams as needed to provide solutions.
* Monitor account performance and identify opportunities to improve sales, product visibility, and overall business growth.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, reps, and key stakeholders.
* Act as the main point of contact for Codarus representatives and the AS ISR team and/or Marketplace account managers regarding ecommerce account information and support.
* Prepare and distribute reports, sales updates, product information, and other requested business insights.
* Coordinate new product launches, assortment updates, pricing changes, and content updates across assigned accounts.
* Ensure account data and product information remain accurate and up to date across customer platforms.
* Escalate and help resolve customer issues, content discrepancies, and operational challenges.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Operations, and Product teams to support customer needs and business objectives.

**You Have**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in ecommerce, account management, customer support, sales operations, or a related field.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
* Experience working with ecommerce marketplaces, wholesale accounts, product content, and digital assets is preferred.
* Ability to analyze information, identify opportunities, and recommend solutions.
* Self-motivated with a proactive, customer-focused approach.

**Your Life and Career at RugsUSA**

* A culture that promotes a healthy work/life balance
* Benefits package offered to all eligible full-time employees (including medical, dental, vision, PTO, 401(k)
* Exposure to career advancement opportunities across all departments
* Generous employee discount that can be used across our house of brands!

  
**The pay range for this role is:**  
75,000 - 90,000 USD per year(Manhattan Office)

jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Account Manager, AMER
jobs.description:
**ABOUT TALON.ONE:**

  

Talon.One is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, promotions and gamification into one holistic platform. Backed by enterprise-grade security and scalability, Talon.One empowers companies to build personalized, profitable promotions and loyalty programs using any data.

Today, over 250 of the world's most-loved brands including Adidas, Sephora and Carlsberg work with Talon.One to drive deeper engagement and lasting loyalty with their customers.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Join our team as an Enterprise Technical Account Manager at Talon.One, where you'll play a key role in driving the success of our API-first promotion engine for our enterprise clients across the growing Americas region. You'll take ownership of the technical integration process, ensuring our platform fits seamlessly into each client's ecosystem. As the technical lead for your portfolio, you'll proactively monitor API usage, resolve recurring issues, and manage escalations in close collaboration with our Engineering and Customer Success teams.

You'll lead onboarding design, manage expectations, and deliver consistent value that boosts retention, growth, and satisfaction. In this strategic role, you'll also explore new tech partnerships and integration opportunities that expand our ecosystem and unlock more value for our customers.

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM:**

Our global team of 15+ Technical Account Managers is spread across the world, including EMEA, US, and APAC. We always strive for a seamless client onboarding and bug-free integration, while balancing ever-changing client requests on a daily basis. Our team works closely with Customer Success Managers and the development team, enabling us to act as consultants to all parties involved in the client onboarding journey. Ultimately, handling expectations related to the integration of our platform is where we drive value for our clients & our company.

Our team is defined by our commitment to mutual support and our dedication to deep problem-solving. These qualities are essential in future teammates in order for us to continue building on our strengths.

The estimated total compensation for this role is $115,500, though actual compensation may vary depending on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, certifications, and location. The salary range is subject to change and may be adjusted at any time. For this role, you must be located within commuting distance of one of our US hubs: New York, Chicago, San Francisco, or Boston.

  

**ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:**

* Own the end-to-end technical integration of our API-driven platform into each client's ecosystem
* Troubleshoot recurring technical issues and drive escalations through to resolution
* Manage a portfolio of enterprise accounts, tracking API usage to protect retention, growth, and satisfaction
* Partner with Customer Success Managers and Engineering to deliver a strong client experience
* Design and continuously improve customer onboarding processes
* Identify new technology partnerships and integration opportunities that expand our ecosystem
* Guide customers through expectation-setting conversations that build long-term trust
* Support escalated tickets alongside the broader support team

  

**WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:**

* 4+ years of previous experience working as a Technical Account Manager, Integrations Consultant, , or similar technical client-facing role
* Experience owning API integrations end-to-end for enterprise-level accounts
* Demonstrated ability to successfully handle the demands of Enterprise accounts, including complex stakeholder management
* Proven experience with SaaS based products
* High level of problem-solving attitude in a troubleshooting environment
* Excellent written communication skills with the ability to explain complex topics in easily understood and concise language to both technical and non-technical professionals
* Stay calm, patient, and professional while managing high-stakes customer relationships
* Analytical understanding with a high focus on data-driven decision-making

  

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Learning budget and LinkedIn Learning
* Competitive salaries & 401(k) plan w/match
* Medical, dental, & life insurance
* Flexible PTO
* Mental health support with Nilo.health

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Account Management
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Manager, Technical Account Management to build and lead the team of Technical Account Managers who own the technical relationship with our customers. Your team is accountable for how each customer deploys, adopts, and gets value from Cyberhaven's Agentic Data Security platform, from onboarding through renewal. You will hire and develop the team, define how TAMs work with accounts, and make sure customers get a consistent, proactive technical partner and experience.

You are a people leader with a technical background in security SaaS and endpoint agents, and you are comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where the team's processes are still being written. You will coach TAMs on and step in on critical escalations when needed. You will also work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support Engineering, Customer Experience, and Sales to turn what the team learns from customers into improvements to the product and to how we serve customers.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience leading customer-facing technical teams are required. You will report to the VP of Support and Technical Account Management.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead and grow the team**

* Hire, onboard, and develop Technical Account Managers. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback, and run career development and performance reviews.
* Coach TAMs on account strategy, technical troubleshooting, executive communication, and managing difficult customer situations.
* Build a team culture of growth mindset, ownership, curiosity, and accountability for customer outcomes.
* Plan headcount and coverage as the customer base grows, including how accounts are assigned and balanced across the team.

### **Define how the TAM function operates**

* Establish the TAM operating model: account segmentation, coverage, engagement cadence, business review format, and technical success plans.
* Set the team's goals and metrics, such as account health, agent coverage and deployment progress, adoption, escalation volume and time to resolution, and customer satisfaction. Report on them to leadership.
* Create and maintain playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge base standards so TAMs handle common situations the same way.
* Define the handoffs between TAMs and Customer Experience and Sales so customers always know who owns what.

### **Own customer outcomes**

* Review account health across the team's book of business and step in early on accounts at risk of low adoption, deployment problems, or churn.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues. Make sure TAMs bring clear reproductions and context to Engineering, and that customers stay informed through resolution.
* Build relationships with customes, and join executive and business reviews for strategic accounts.
* Work with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.

### **Be the voice of the customer**

* Collect customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring issues from the team and bring them to Product Management and Engineering with the technical and business context behind them.
* Work with Engineering and Support Engineering to improve diagnostics, debugging tools, and escalation processes.
* Run root cause analysis reviews on significant incidents and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.
* Stay current on industry trends, security best practices, and adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA, and bring them into the team's guidance to customers.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 3+ years of experience managing a team of Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, Solutions Engineers, or similar customer-facing technical staff.
* 7+ years in customer-facing technical roles.
* Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong technical people, and of handling performance issues directly and fairly.
* Experience building or scaling a TAM, Support, or Customer Success function, including processes, playbooks, and metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience managing escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, set timelines, and track progress across a team and its accounts.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, enterprise network infrastructure, and Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint management (SCCM, GPO, Intune, MDM, and application management).
* Ability to read and interpret logs and diagnostic output across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine well enough to coach others and guide technical investigations.

### **Desired**

* Familiarity with adjacent technologies that Cyberhaven integrates with (SIEM, SOAR, UEBA).
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.
* Prior experience leading a TAM team at a security or SaaS company.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth company where the team's processes were still being defined.
* Background in L2/L3 or Escalation Engineering for EDR or DLP tools.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Help shape how J.P. Morgan Payments shows up in market - and why customers should care. In this role, you'll turn business and product priorities into a clear narrative and creative strategy that builds authority over time.

As a Vice President, Brand Strategy in J.P. Morgan Payments, you will define the narrative and creative strategy behind our biggest market investments. You'll bring the customer point of view into a complex, global organization and use audience insight to sharpen what we say and make. You'll partner closely with stakeholders, agencies, and our creative studio to ensure the work is coherent across touchpoints and compounds over time.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Translate business, product, and go-to-market priorities into a clear market narrative and creative strategy.
* Define an audience-centered point of view that builds brand authority and cultural capital over time.
* Steward how the brand shows up across flagship programs and key touchpoints.
* Own audience testing end-to-end, including participants, questions, and stimulus.
* Balance learning (what resonates) with validation (what we must prove to build alignment and confidence).
* Partner with agencies to distill findings into clear, actionable recommendations that elevate the work.
* Partner with the creative studio to define what the work must accomplish and what “good” looks like.
* Use audience insight to guide decisions—sharpening metaphors, focusing copy, and raising creative craft.
* Define clear assignments and translate competing stakeholder input into usable direction for agency partners.
* Lead agency partners to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.
* Leverage marketing science to raise the standard for how a matrixed organization shows up in market.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:**

* Apply marketing science to build strategies and drive focus (including category entry points, the 95:5 rule, and System 1/System 2 thinking).
* Build an audience-centered point of view that earns authority through the work, not just claims.
* Distill ambiguity and competing inputs into a clear path forward.
* Influence stakeholders without formal authority, knowing when to hold the line and when to compromise.
* Bring deep audience obsession, pressure-testing decisions against what matters to customers.
* Translate complexity into a coherent narrative that connects across touchpoints and compounds over time.
* Operate fluidly across strategy and execution—moving from insight to assignment to strong delivery.
* Rally teams around a shared vision and change minds, including in resistant rooms.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:**

* Bring experience building brand and narrative strategy inside a highly matrixed, global organization.

jobs.title: Shipping & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location:** Upper East Side, Manhattan, NYC.

**Hours:** Full-time, five days a week, 10:00 – 6:00 (37.5 hours/week). Saturday availability is required.

**Salary:** $50,000

**Reporting to:** Gallery Manager

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a reliable, meticulous and proactive [insert job title here] to join our New York team. This is a hands-on role, and shipping, logistics and operations are the core of it: packing and dispatching rare books and works on paper, handling couriers and customs documentation, keeping detailed shipping logs, moving and caring for stock, preparing for book fairs, and ensuring that the gallery runs smoothly day to day.

The position is entry-level, but we are looking for someone to take real ownership of it. Shipping and operations in New York will be this person's department to run, and there is room to grow as this side of the business expands.

At least one year's experience in shipping, logistics or operations is preferred. Short of that, we will consider candidates who can demonstrate a real interest in the work and a willingness to learn it properly.

**Duties will include, but are not limited to:**

**Shipping & Receiving:**

* Package and prepare books, prints, artworks, and other items for both international and domestic shipping.
* Coordinate with the UK shipping team to prepare shipping labels and supporting documentation for US and international deliveries.
* Liaise with couriers and postal service providers to ensure timely and cost-effective deliveries.
* Deliver goods locally between Peter Harrington New York, bookstores, galleries, auction houses, trade fairs, and clients.
* Log incoming and outgoing goods and maintain accurate, well-organized records.
* Assist with the organization and setup of book fairs, including staffing arrangements and packing and unpacking book fair trunks.
* Apply protective coverings and ensure the appropriate care of incoming and existing stock.
* Perform porterage and internal circulation of items.

**Logistics & Compliance:**

* Manage accounts and relationships with couriers, freight forwarders and postal providers; obtain quotes and ensure deliveries are timely and cost-effective.
* Prepare and check customs documentation for international shipments, including commercial invoices, tariff codes and country-of-origin declarations.
* Arrange transit insurance, ensure values are declared correctly, and handle claims for loss or damage.
* Track consignments through to delivery, resolving delays, customs holds and missing parcels.
* Monitor shipping costs against budget and recommend improvements to carriers, materials or process.
* Maintain and improve the department's procedures and documentation so that shipping runs consistently and can be picked up by others when needed.

**Operations & Facilities:**

* Take day-to-day responsibility for the smooth running of the New York premises.
* Schedule and oversee facilities projects from start to finish with minimal supervision, liaising with contractors and building management.
* Carry out basic repairs and maintenance, and keep the gallery and office presentable — including tidying, dusting, and ad hoc or emergency cleaning.
* Manage the layout and upkeep of office and gallery space: furniture, equipment, storage and removals.
* Maintain inventory of office, kitchen and packing supplies, reordering proactively so that nothing runs out mid-shipment.
* Act as the first point of contact for IT issues on site, liaising with the IT department in London and with external vendors.
* Run occasional business-related errands as required.

**Bookfairs & Events:**

* Prepare stock for fairs: packing and unpacking trunks, preparing lists, and ensuring shipments arrive on schedule.
* Assist with the organisation and set-up of book fairs, including staffing arrangements and stand build.
* Assist with the set-up and coordination of gallery events and other ad hoc activities, liaising with venues and external suppliers.

**Essential Skills and Experience:**

* Previous experience handling, packing, or shipping valuable, fragile, or collectible items.
* Stellar time management skills.
* Meticulous attention to detail.
* Initiative and a proactive approach to responsibilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, along with strong numeracy.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels.
* Professionalism and confidence when interacting with a diverse range of clients and colleagues.
* Effective team player with a collaborative approach.

**Job Description:**

The Admissions Operations Assistant provides administrative and operational support to the Enrollment Division and plays an important role in ensuring the efficient day-to-day operations of the Admissions Department. Responsibilities include maintaining accurate student records, processing admissions materials, supporting office mailings, and completing routine data entry and document management tasks. The position follows established procedures and works under the direction of Admissions leadership to provide consistent and reliable operational support. While the position may work with systems such as Slate and Banner, it is not responsible for the overall administration, configuration, or strategic management of these systems. **Job Responsibilities:**

* Provide general administrative and operational support UMSV’s Graduate and Undergraduate Admissions teams.
* Process, organize, scan, file, and appropriately dispose of admissions documents and other office materials, including confidential document shredding.
* Assist with incoming and outgoing email, physical mail, admissions mailings, acceptance materials, event materials, and other large-scale communication projects.
* Sort, review, clean, and organize Excel spreadsheets and other data files.
* Perform routine data entry and record maintenance in Slate, Banner, and other university systems.
* Review student records for completeness and assist with identifying missing or incorrectly entered information.
* Upload, match, and organize application materials and supporting documents within student records.
* Assist with routine Slate operational tasks, queries, exports, and data cleanup as assigned.
* Support data reconciliation between Slate, Banner, spreadsheets, and other institutional records.
* Conduct secondary reviews of admission applications and supporting materials when trained and assigned.
* Assist with processing transcripts and other admissions credentials in accordance with established office procedures including their evaluation and upload
* Prepare materials for recruitment events, campus visits, admitted student programs, and other Admissions initiatives.
* Assemble packets, labels, envelopes, giveaway materials, and other supplies for

**Admissions programs and communications**

* Support audits and data-quality projects to ensure admissions records are accurate and complete.
* Perform other administrative and operational duties as assigned to support the day-to-day functions of Admissions.

 **Requirements**  

* Associate degree or higher required. Candidates with a high school diploma with equivalent and relevant experience in CRM systems, database management, or related administrative operations will also be considered.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to accurately complete administrative and data-entry tasks.
* Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* Comfort learning and working within database and technology systems, spreadsheets, and able to manage repetitive administrative tasks with a high degree of accuracy.
* Ability to handle confidential student information with discretion and in accordance with university policies.
* Previous experience with Slate, Banner, or other higher education student information or CRM systems is preferred but not required.

**The allotted hourly rate is $26.50.**

jobs.description:
Outside Sales Representative – Loading Dock Equipment

**Extreme Dock Equipment** is a growing manufacturer of loading dock equipment based in Southern California. We manufacture **dock seals, dock shelters, and related loading dock products** and sell through distributors throughout the United States.

We are looking for an experienced **Outside Sales Representative** to build and grow our **East Coast and Midwest territory — everything east of Denver, CO.**

**Home-based position | Atlanta, Charlotte, or Columbus preferred | Extensive travel**

**The more you build, the more you earn.**

A performance bonus is also available for achieving defined territory-development and customer-acquisition goals.

The Opportunity

This is a **territory-building position**, not an account-maintenance role.

You will be responsible for developing Extreme Dock Equipment's distributor network throughout the territory and creating new business.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

* Prospecting and developing new distributor accounts
* Building relationships with loading dock and material handling distributors
* Growing sales through distributor sales teams
* Identifying new market opportunities
* Calling on distributor owners, purchasing managers, sales managers, and outside salespeople
* Training distributor sales teams on Extreme Dock Equipment products
* Developing opportunities and following up on quotes
* Managing your sales pipeline
* Traveling throughout the territory to meet distributors and customers
* Attending industry trade shows and customer meetings
* Monitoring competitors and providing market feedback
* Building long-term relationships that produce repeat business

You will have significant responsibility for **building and growing the territory**.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for an experienced B2B outside salesperson with a background in **loading dock equipment, material handling, warehouse equipment, industrial products, construction products, or a closely related industry.**

Strongly preferred experience:

* Loading dock equipment
* Dock seals and dock shelters
* Dock levelers
* Vehicle restraints
* Industrial doors
* Material handling equipment
* Warehouse equipment
* Industrial or commercial construction products
* Distributor/dealer sales

**Experience selling through distributors is strongly preferred.**

The ideal candidate understands how the loading dock and material handling industry works and has existing relationships with distributors or end users in the territory.

What We're Looking For

* 2+ years of successful outside sales experience
* Proven ability to develop new business
* B2B sales experience
* Strong prospecting skills
* Strong relationship-building skills
* Excellent communication and follow-up
* Comfortable selling to business owners and decision-makers
* Comfortable training distributor sales teams
* Self-motivated and able to work independently

* Competitive and motivated by results

Territory

**All markets east of Denver, Colorado.**

The territory includes the:

* Midwest
* Great Lakes
* Southeast
* Mid-Atlantic
* Northeast

This is a **home-based position with significant travel throughout the territory.**

**Preferred locations:** Atlanta, GA; Charlotte, NC; or Columbus, OH.

Exceptional candidates located elsewhere within the territory will also be considered.

Why Extreme Dock Equipment?

Extreme Dock Equipment is a growing manufacturer with an opportunity to significantly expand its distributor network across the United States.

This position will work directly with company leadership and will have a meaningful role in determining how the territory develops.

You won't be inheriting a mature territory and simply maintaining existing accounts.

**You'll be building it.**

We are looking for someone who wants to develop a substantial book of business and be rewarded for the results they produce.

If you're an experienced industrial salesperson who enjoys prospecting, building relationships, and winning new business, this is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the growth of a manufacturing company.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About IconicCare**

IconicCare places an in-house physiatrist in skilled nursing facilities at no cost to the facility. Our providers

are in the building 2–3 days a week, focused on pain management, function, and skin integrity. That means

patients hit their discharge function goals, opioid use comes down, and falls and hospital readmissions drop.

We were founded by physiatrist Dr. Christian Morris, and we're growing quickly into new markets.

**The role**

You'll own the greater Atlanta metro. You'll visit skilled nursing facilities across the metro, build relationships with

Administrators and Directors of Nursing, and set up alignment calls with Dr. Morris and our Director of

Revenue Operations. You don't need a clinical background, because Dr. Morris handles the clinical

conversation on the call. Your job is building trust in the building and getting the right people on the

calendar.

Because this is a home territory, you'll be back in the same buildings regularly. Those who do best here

turn a front-desk hello into a first-name relationship with the DON.

If you're picturing struggling to get past the front desk and getting shown the door, this is the opposite. Facilities need

what we have. In-house physiatry is in high demand and hard to find, and most buildings have been trying to

get this kind of coverage for a long time. When you walk in, you're not selling something. You're a partner to our

clinical team, helping facilities get the care their patients need.

When it's done right, staff don't see you as a marketer. They see you as part of the clinical care team, someone

who understands their challenges and connects them with Dr. Morris for the full clinical picture. Doors open

easily, and getting in front of the Administrator and Director of Nursing in person is usually the easy part.

**Who we want (and who we don't)**

We want people who learn quickly and are incredibly friendly/personable. We'll teach you the industry.

We are intentionally not looking for marketing reps from wound care, therapy, hospice, or other SNF vendor

companies. We want a different kind of presence in these buildings, not the one administrators already hear from

every week. You need to be good at following a system, keeping notes, and making friends.

**What you'll do**

* Repeatedly visit a set route of facilities across your metro.
* Build repeat relationships with front desk staff, Administrators, and DONs
* Set up alignment calls with both the Administrator and the DON attending
* Log every visit and meeting in HubSpot
* Keep a clean pipeline so every booked call is ready for a smooth handoff

**Full-time or part-time:**

You choose whether to work full-time or part-time. Full-time reps are eligible for company benefits,

including health, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k). Part-time reps set a schedule that fits their life

and can still choose any of the three pay plans below. On a plan with a base salary, the base is prorated to

the time you work each month, and your bonus rates stay the same as a full-time employee on that plan.

**Choose how you're paid**

Everyone comes into this role with different goals, and life circumstances, so you choose how you're paid. We offer three

compensation plans, and every one is built around a $100,000 on target annual income for full-time employees:

* **Full Commission**. The highest commission rates and the most upside, for reps who want every dollar tied

to their results.

* **Base + commission**. A guaranteed base salary with reduced commission rates, for steadier income while

you build your territory.

* **Partial Base + commission**. A smaller base with commission rates in between, for a balance of stability and upside.

On every plan, you get paid at multiple stages as a facility moves forward, from the first initial meeting through

signing. Commission is uncapped, and top performers earn well past the on target earning of $100,000. We'll walk through the exact numbers for each plan in your interview.

**Mileage & Travel**: reimbursed at company rate

**Requirements**

* Reliable vehicle and valid driver's license
* Able to pass a background check and meet facility visitor requirements
* A professional, trustworthy, kind presence in a healthcare setting

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
50,000 - 150,000 USD per year(Atlanta, GA)

**Customer Success Manager, Manufacturing**

At Poka, we're changing how the world's industrial teams work, capturing the knowledge of their best people and putting it in every operator's hands.

Our connected worker platform is purpose-built for manufacturing and the wider industrial world, with industrial AI inside the shift, not on top of it. The result: frontline performance that becomes compounding knowledge and measurable impact, every shift, every site, every region.

**Job Summary**

The **Growth Marketing Manager, Digital** is responsible for driving incremental sales, customer acquisition, frequency, and profitable growth across Papa Johns' third-party marketplace partnerships, including DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Walmart Express, and future aggregator platforms. This role will lead the development and execution of growth strategies across aggregator channels, including joint business planning, promotional programming, sponsored listings, media investments, merchandising, menu optimization, customer acquisition, retention, and marketplace innovation.

The role is responsible for maximizing the value of third-party channels while not cannibalizing 1st party. This includes identifying opportunities to attract new customers, re-engage lapsed customers, increase frequency among existing customers, and create integrated programs that leverage the strengths of both aggregator and owned digital ecosystems. The role is responsible for partnering across Marketing, Analytics, Revenue Management, Operations, Finance, and agency teams to deliver growth objectives aligned with annual business goals. This role will drive customer growth and commercial objectives through a strong understanding of marketplace dynamics, customer behavior, digital marketing, data analytics, and strategic partnership management. This role will help shape the future of Papa Johns' digital growth ecosystem by developing scalable marketplace strategies, identifying new growth opportunities, and creating best-in-class commercial programs that accelerate market share and profitable growth.

**Duties and Responsibilities (other duties as assigned)**

* Lead day-to-day management of key aggregator partnerships that will focus on one or two of the following - DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Walmart Express, and emerging marketplace platforms
* Support development and execute annual joint business plans with aggregator partners to achieve sales, customer acquisition, frequency, and profitability objectives
* Manage aggregator marketing budgets, promotional investments, sponsored listings, and co-funded media programs to maximize return on investment
* Identify, negotiate, and execute high-impact promotional programs, exclusive offers, seasonal campaigns, and strategic growth initiatives
* Develop strategies that maximize the complementary roles of first-party and third-party channels, ensuring each platform contributes to customer acquisition, engagement, frequency, and long-term growth
* Identify opportunities to acquire new customers, re-engage lapsed customers, and increase order frequency through aggregator-specific programs, offers, and partnerships
* Lead marketplace merchandising strategy, including menu optimization, placement, ratings, search visibility, imagery, content quality, and conversion performance
* Create and manage aggregator performance scorecards, monitoring sales, orders, customer acquisition, retention, profitability, and share of category metrics
* Analyze marketplace, customer, and competitive performance data to identify opportunities and develop recommendations that drive incremental growth
* Evaluate and pilot new aggregator products, capabilities, technologies, and marketing opportunities to maintain competitive advantage
* Develop business cases and secure leadership alignment for new growth initiatives, partnerships, and investment opportunities
* Build strong relationships with aggregator partner leadership and influence roadmaps that support Papa Johns growth objectives
* Monitor performance against business objectives and implement corrective actions to improve growth, profitability, and customer outcomes
* Build strong and high-quality storytelling through decks, business reviews, and executive presentations for key internal stakeholders and external partners

**Education, Experience & Certifications**

* 5+ years business experience in digital marketing, eCommerce, marketplace, delivery, growth marketing, or related fields
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Analytics, or related field; MBA preferred
* Experience managing marketplace, aggregator, retail media, or digital commerce partnerships preferred

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Night Operations Coordinator

**Department:** House Operations  
**Reports To:** House Manager
  
**FLSA Status:** Non-Exempt

**Employment Status:** Full Time  
**Date Revised:** October 2026

**Job Purpose**

The Night Operations Coordinator supports safe, efficient House operations during evening and overnight hours and provides shift coverage and operational support for House, Evening, Night, and Weekend Managers as needed. This position fosters a warm, comfortable, and secure environment for Guest Families, volunteers, and visitors while ensuring continuity of House services.

**Work Hours**

This is a full-time, on-site position with standard hours of Monday through Friday, 10:30 p.m. to 7:00 a.m., when not covering an alternate shift. Flexibility for evenings, nights, and weekends is required.

**Essential Functions**

**Emergency & Facilities Response:**

* Perform routine House walkthroughs/facility inspections and update maintenance records in Family Registry as needed.
* Ensure the environment is kept neat and clean at all times.
* Adhere to health and insurance safety standards required for Ronald McDonald Houses.
* Supervise House cleaning or maintenance tasks as directed by the Facilities Manager.
* Conduct emergency repairs when necessary.
* Keep all storage areas organized and tidy.
* Monitor fire alarms, smoke detectors, and phone systems to ensure they are always operational.
* Address any emergency maintenance needs during scheduled work time and contact Facilities Manager immediately if needed.

**House Management:**

* Cover shifts for House Managers as needed, including evening, night, and weekend hours.
* Manage office operations and House activity during scheduled shifts.
* Oversee referrals, room assignments, and guest check-in/check-out procedures.
* Coordinate with hotel partners for overflow lodging when applicable.
* Maintain accurate guest data in Family Registry and other database systems.
* Respond to phone calls and in-person inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
* Carry the House emergency phone during all work hours and respond as needed.
* Assist with inventory tracking & communicate supply needs to the House Manager.
* Support weekly room checks and daily walkthroughs to assess cleanliness, safety, and guest comfort.
* Document maintenance and housekeeping needs and notify Facilities Manager.
* Ensure accurate in-kind donation records are completed for all items received during assigned shifts.
* Maintain professional communication with hospital referral staff.
* Follow all accounting procedures and Ronald McDonald House Atlanta documentation protocols.

**Guest, Donor, and Volunteer Relations:**

* Maintain a clean environment and create an atmosphere of hospitality, ensuring the well-being and comfort of families.
* Clarify and tactfully enforce Ronald McDonald House Guest Rules/Policies and Procedures.
* Articulate the mission and vision of the Charity, including its history; provide House tours as needed.
* Promote community awareness of Ronald McDonald House Atlanta.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support the House and its mission.

**Qualifications**

* College degree and work experience in Human Services.
* Excellent communication, organizational, time management, sound judgment, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to conduct oneself tactfully in dealing with Guest Families and volunteers.
* Experience working with infirm or disabled children and families.
* Exceptional customer service skills with the ability to interact effectively with a broad range of constituents including families, volunteers, staff, and community members.
* Ability to work and remain calm under pressure, meet multiple deadlines, and multitask effectively.
* Commitment to service, organizational values, and professionalism, demonstrated through conduct and demeanor at all times.
* Work in a positive and nurturing manner with volunteers, community groups, donors, and support staff in the House.
* Highly motivated self-starter with strategic thinking ability; able to work independently as well as collaboratively with a team-oriented personality.
* Possess compassion, tact, honesty, trustworthiness, good listening skills, flexibility, and professionalism.
* Demonstrate respect for the privacy and confidentiality of all Guests.
* Show genuine interest in the successful operation of both House programs.
* Ability to express ideas clearly, concisely, and logically, both orally and in writing.
* Visual acuity sufficient to operate a computer terminal and read extensively.
* Working knowledge of computers with competency in Microsoft 365 and database programs.
* Above all, capable of thinking clearly and reacting professionally while providing comfort to individuals during personal trauma, such as dealing with a child's chronic illness or death.
* Must be in good general health to ensure the well-being of the families.

**Key Competencies**

* Compassion and empathy
* Tact and discretion
* Initiative and flexibility
* Collaboration and teamwork
* Attention to detail
* Accountability and professionalism

**Working Conditions & Physical Demands**

* Must be able to lift and transport up to 50 pounds.
* Sit at a desk approximately 30–40% of the day.
* Frequent walking, standing, and stair climbing.
* Ability to climb stairs and access mechanical/utility areas.
* Visual and auditory acuity required for communication, safety, and documentation.

**Disclaimer**

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Management reserves the right to revise or amend duties as needed due to business necessity or organizational changes.

We are seeking a talented and motivated Land Development Assistant Project Manager to join our growing team and support a variety of commercial, industrial, and site development projects.

jobs.title: Drayage Account Manager - Chicago
jobs.description:
This Is Not a Maintenance Role

Amnex Solutions is looking for a high-output Drayage Account Manager who can take ownership of demanding customer accounts, move freight under pressure, protect profitability, and create growth.

We are not looking for someone who simply forwards emails, updates spreadsheets, or waits for instructions. We need someone who anticipates problems, makes decisions, drives communication, and treats every account like a business within the business.

If a container is approaching last free day, you are already working on the solution. If a carrier falls off, you immediately coordinate recovery. If a customer has additional freight, you recognize the opportunity and pursue it. You do not wait for problems—or revenue—to find you.

**About Amnex Solutions**

Amnex Solutions Corp is one of the fastest-growing 4PLs in the country, specializing in drayage, intermodal, and OTR transportation throughout the United States.

Founded in January 1, 2024 by transportation professionals with more than 16 years of industry experience, Amnex has grown at an extraordinary pace by solving problems others cannot, responding faster than the competition, and holding its team to an uncompromising standard of execution.

We are building a dominant national logistics organization—not a comfortable, slow-moving brokerage. The people who join us now will have the opportunity to help shape the company, build major customer accounts, and grow into leadership positions as we continue expanding.

**The Mission**

As a Drayage Account Manager, you will take command of assigned customer accounts from order acceptance through final delivery, empty return, documentation, and billing.

Your mission is straightforward:

Keep containers moving.  

Keep customers informed.  
Eliminate preventable accessorials.  
Protect and improve margins.  
Solve problems before they escalate.  
Expand the accounts under your control.  

You will have support from carrier sales, tracking, accounting, and company leadership—but ownership of the account belongs to you.

**What You Will Own**

**Customer Accounts**

Serve as the primary point of contact and operational authority for assigned customers.  

Learn each customer’s business, facilities, SOPs, priorities, and service expectations.  
Provide fast, accurate, and proactive communication without making customers chase you for updates.  
Build enough trust that customers bring additional lanes, locations, and projects directly to you.  
Identify weaknesses in the customer’s transportation network and present Amnex solutions.  
Turn excellent execution into measurable account growth.  

**Drayage Execution**

Manage import and export container shipments through ports, rail terminals, warehouses, distribution centers, and customer facilities.  

Confirm releases, availability, last free days, appointments, equipment requirements, customs status, delivery requirements, and empty-return instructions.  
Track every shipment through pickup, delivery, empty return, documentation, and financial closeout.  
Monitor demurrage, detention, per diem, storage, chassis usage, and other accessorial exposure.  
Prevent avoidable charges through aggressive follow-up, planning, and escalation.  
Build recovery plans when appointments fail, terminals close, containers are unavailable, carriers fall off, or customer requirements change.  
Maintain accurate and complete shipment information in Turvo.  

**Profitability and Growth**

Understand the revenue, cost, margin, and risk associated with every shipment.  

Protect margins while maintaining the service required to retain and grow the account.  
Challenge unnecessary costs and identify operational inefficiencies.  
Work with carrier sales to develop dedicated capacity and stronger pricing.  
Recognize expansion opportunities and actively pursue additional customer volume.  
Treat assigned accounts as businesses that must become larger, stronger, and more profitable over time.  

**Carrier Coordination**

Partner with the carrier sales team to secure reliable capacity at competitive rates.  

Build productive relationships with high-performing drayage carriers and dispatch teams.  
Confirm rates, appointments, equipment, driver information, terminal access, and service requirements before dispatch.  
Ensure carriers meet Amnex insurance, safety, compliance, and onboarding standards.  
Hold carriers accountable for communication, documentation, and service performance.  
Help develop dedicated capacity for recurring lanes and major projects.  

**Documentation and Financial Closeout**

Collect PODs, interchange receipts, gate tickets, scale tickets, lumper receipts, invoices, and other required documents.  

Confirm that accessorial charges are valid, documented, and communicated promptly.  
Maintain complete shipment records so accounting can bill customers and pay carriers accurately.  
Resolve missing documentation, rate discrepancies, and outstanding charges before they delay closeout.  

**The Standard**

At Amnex, strong performance means more than keeping up with email.

A successful Drayage Account Manager:

Knows the status and next action for every active shipment.  

Communicates problems before the customer discovers them.  
Moves quickly without sacrificing accuracy.  
Takes ownership instead of passing responsibility.  
Follows through until every issue is completely resolved.  
Maintains control when operations become chaotic.  
Protects the company’s reputation and profitability.  
Consistently expands the value of assigned accounts.  
Raises the performance of the people around them.  

**Required Qualifications**

At least two years of meaningful experience in drayage, intermodal, container logistics, freight brokerage, or a comparable transportation environment.  

Strong working knowledge of port and rail operations, steamship-line systems, terminal procedures, container availability, appointments, last free da

**Customer Success Manager, Manufacturing**

At Poka, we're changing how the world's industrial teams work, capturing the knowledge of their best people and putting it in every operator's hands.

Our connected worker platform is purpose-built for manufacturing and the wider industrial world, with industrial AI inside the shift, not on top of it. The result: frontline performance that becomes compounding knowledge and measurable impact, every shift, every site, every region.

jobs.description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

**About the Team**

You'll join the Sales Development team, part of Workday's Field Sales organization. This team builds the quality pipeline that powers Workday's growth, partnering closely with Account Executives to identify, engage, and develop relationships with future customers across target accounts. It's a great place to grow: you'll be part of Workday's collaborative culture from day one, and the role offers a clear path to build foundational sales skills and advance your career within the broader sales organization.

**About the Role**

As a **Sales Development Representative** , you will deploy multi-channel prospecting strategies and partner with Account Executives to build and advance quality opportunities for the Workday sales team. You will connect with potential customers, share Workday's value, and uncover what matters most to each prospect and their organization.

  

In this role, you will be responsible for:

* Deploying multi-channel prospecting strategies across target accounts, including phone, email, social selling, and in-person events
* Partnering with Account Executives to build and advance quality opportunities for Workday field sales
* Contacting potential customers, sharing Workday's value, and uncovering prospects' needs and organizational challenges
* Identifying and qualifying potential buyers to help generate a healthy, growing pipeline
* Nurturing and developing relationships between prospective accounts and the broader Workday team
* Responding to and qualifying marketing qualified leads in a timely, effective manner
* Staying organized while managing multiple prospecting activities and accounts at the same time

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications**

***Sales Development Representative (S2):***

* 1+ years of professional or industry-related experience with a Bachelor's degree in a related field, or 2+ years of professional or industry-related experience where a Bachelor’s degree is not present.
* Experience in prospecting, inside sales, business development, marketing, direct sales, or consulting.

***Senior Sales Development Representative (S3):***

* 2+ years of direct software, SaaS, or technology sales experience, or equivalent business-to-business prospecting experience
Experience in prospecting, inside sales, business development, marketing, direct sales, or consulting.  

  

**Other Qualifications**

* **Building Pipeline:** Experience identifying potential leads, nurturing them through early-stage engagement, and growing a consistent pipeline through outreach activities
* **Relationship Building:** Experience establishing genuine connections with prospects and internal teammates through clear communication and trust
* **Business Acumen:** Experience learning customer environments, market trends, and organizational landscapes to position Workday effectively in prospecting conversations
* **Value Propositions:** Experience identifying and communicating the unique value of a solution in ways that resonate with different audiences and address customer needs
* **Credibility:** Experience building confidence with prospects and partners through consistency, honesty, and continued learning
* Familiarity with sales tools such as Salesforce, Clari Groove, and ZoomInfo
SaaS sales experience

RTS is part of Shamrock Trading Corporation, a family of brands that has been serving the transportation and logistics industries since 1986. Shamrock offers factoring solutions, export financing, third-party logistics, a fuel card program and trucking technology.

Why You’ll Love Working Here
  
Our award-winning culture is a testament to our commitment to growth, recognition and empowerment. From day one, we prioritize employees first, encouraging them to think and act like owners and providing endless opportunities for growth and self-development, both personally and professionally. Shamrock has been recognized as one of America’s 2025 “Most Loved Workplaces” by Newsweek.
  
At Shamrock, we hire bright, ambitious people and give them the tools they need for a successful, long-term career here. Shamrock also offers a premier set of benefits for employees and their families:
  

* Unlimited Earnings: Uncapped commission, competitive base salary and ongoing opportunities to advance your professional career
* Training and Development: Industry-leading training programs, including a Freight Immersion Training (FIT) Program for sales employees entering the transportation industry

* Recognition and Awards: Sales incentives, quarterly employee awards and opportunities to celebrate individual and team success
* Work-Life Balance: Competitive PTO, fully paid time off for holidays and opportunities to volunteer within your community

About the Role
  
RTS and Shamrock Trading Corporation are looking for a Business Development Representative. This entry-level sales role will focus on supporting and managing new and existing accounts for RTS. An ideal candidate will be self-motivated with a dynamic, ambitious and outgoing personality.
  
What You’ll Do
  

* Work closely with sales teams to set up new business and ensure successful onboarding
* Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships through clear communication
* Analyze existing client accounts to identify, upsell and cross-sell sales growth opportunities
* Negotiate spreads and maximize profitability on all business
* Ensure the timely and successful delivery of requests and solutions according to client needs and objectives
* Communicate the status of all client relationships clearly and timely
* Participate in strategic planning, including corporate positioning, competitive analysis, customer segment selection and penetration plans
* Assist in product marketing, including product launch management, new business development, presentations, sales tools and competitive analysis
* Continually refine all processes as necessary to stay in front of customers in relevant industries
* Track metrics for all programs and activities
* Other duties as assigned

What You’ll Bring
  

* Bachelor’s degree preferred, and/or 2+ years of customer service or account management experience
* Excellent computer skills (Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite)
* Ability to multi-task and thrive in a fast-paced environment
* Critical thinking and negotiation skills
* Strong interpersonal communication skills, both written and verbal

What Will Put You Ahead
  

* Desire to work in a competitive sales and team environment
* Attention to detail and a goal-driven mindset
* Passion to learn and build relationships
* Self-motivated personality with the confidence to seek guidance and direction as needed
* Bilingual skills

Apply Today!
  
We’re so excited to connect with you! If you want to work with forward-thinking people in an award-winning culture, submit your application today.
  
#LI-KP1 #LI-Onsite #RTS

jobs.title: Operations and Production Coordinator for Hearts of Mercy and Compassion
jobs.description:
Lutheran Church Charities is seeking a Project Manager for its Hearts of Mercy & Compassion Ministry to coordinate inventory, assembly, order fulfillment, shipping, vendor relationships, and volunteers. This hands-on role ensures ministry items are prepared accurately and delivered on time while supporting church affiliates and crisis response logistics. The ideal candidate is organized, collaborative, attentive to detail, and committed to LCC’s mission, with a willingness to share their Christian faith and compassion with those served.

**Position Summary**

HMC Operations and Production Coordinator manages the day-to-day operations of the Hearts of Mercy & Compassion (HMC) Ministry, with a focus on inventory, assembly, order fulfillment, shipping, vendor coordination, volunteers, and related logistics. This role ensures that hearts, fish, crosses, and supplies are ready and delivered on time to support ministry requests, church affiliates, and crisis response.

The person in this position must be committed to LCC’s mission and comfortable sharing their Christian faith to encourage and support those served.

**General Responsibilities**

**Inventory and Vendor Coordination**

* Maintain adequate inventory of hearts, fish, panels, crosses, hardware, paint, decals, packing materials, and other ministry supplies.
* Coordinate with vendors and ministry partners to order products and supplies, monitor delivery timelines, and address quality or availability concerns.
* Identify reliable vendors locally and nationally to support LCC and HMC church affiliates with HMC Director’s approval.
* Organize supplies and finished products so they are accessible and ready for assembly, fulfillment, and deployment.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and anticipate replenishment needs.

**Assembly, Fulfillment, and Shipping**

* Coordinate and participate in the building, painting, customization, and preparation of hearts and crosses using established ministry procedures.
* Schedule work to meet ministry requests and order deadlines.
* Confirm personalization details with requestors and ensure completed items are accurate and meet ministry quality standards.
* Maintain the HMC Parts Order System, including available products and pricing.
* Process affiliate orders, prepare packages, arrange shipping or delivery, and track fulfillment.
* Coordinate Cricut files, supplies, and use for ministry customization.

**Volunteer Coordination**

* Recruit and schedule daily volunteers for special projects when necessary, and support volunteers assisting with building, machining, painting, customization, packing, and related projects.
* Match volunteer assignments to individual abilities and provide clear instructions, materials, and support.
* Coordinate with HMC affiliate teams, who prepare ministry items off-site, ensuring they have the necessary supplies and understand expectations.
* Review completed work for consistency and quality.
* Record volunteer participation in designated software.

**Affiliate Support and Training**

* Serve as a resource for church affiliates regarding supplies, ordering, assembly, customization, and ministry procedures.
* Assist in new affiliate training with HMC Director using established materials and hands-on instruction.
* Keep assembly instructions, painting guides, personalization resources, the Affiliate Manual, and training materials current.
* Assist with creating videos for online affiliate training.
* Support the growth of HMC church affiliates and volunteer and vendor partnerships nationally.

**Ministry Logistics and Crisis Response**

* Coordinate deliveries of hearts and crosses and provide a compassionate ministry presence when delivering items in person.
* Serve as operational backup to the HMC Director in coordinating crisis deployments, including supplies, transportation, placement, setup, and volunteer participation.
* Partner with other LCC ministries on joint deployments and visits.
* Participate in deployments as needed.
* May be asked to represent LCC and HMC at conferences, events, and presentations.

**Records and Operational Support**

* Maintain accurate records of item numbering, inventory, orders, volunteer engagement, and ministry giftings in designated software.
* Identify practical improvements to organization, assembly, packing, and fulfillment processes.
* Work with the Director to coordinate supplies, vendors, and logistics for new ministry items or tools.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Strong organizational skills, including planning, scheduling, recordkeeping, and follow-through.
* Experience coordinating projects, inventory, orders, shipping, volunteers, or similar operations.
* Ability to manage multiple requests and adjust priorities as ministry needs change.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with staff, volunteers, vendors, and church affiliates.
* A collaborative approach to supporting HMC and other LCC ministries.
* Attention to detail and a commitment to accurate orders and quality work.
* Ability to solve problems and make thoughtful decisions, including during crisis response.
* Willingness to participate in hands-on assembly, packing, and preparation of ministry items using established instructions.
* Comfort sharing Christian faith and providing a compassionate ministry presence.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Outlook, Teams, and the ability to learn inventory and ministry tracking software.
* Experience with volunteer coordination, order fulfillment, or shipping preferred.
* Familiarity with Cricut equipment or similar customization tools helpful; willingness to learn is essential.

**About the role**

We're searching for a Logistics & Purchasing Coordinator to keep our freight, purchasing, and service operations running smoothly. You'll book LTL freight, manage domestic and international purchase orders and vendor follow-ups, track inventory, field service and warranty issues, and keep our warehouse team and Director of Operations up to date. This is primarily about [80]% computer and phone work, and [20]% on the warehouse floor checking receiving, staging, and inventory. It's a great fit if you've worked as a logistics coordinator, purchasing assistant, or operations admin and like owning the details.

**What you'll do**

**Freight & logistics**

* Book LTL freight shipments, pickups, and deliveries with carriers
* Track shipments and handle delays, missed pickups, damages, and delivery exceptions
* Keep records of bookings, tracking numbers, and carrier details

**Purchasing & vendors**

* Create and manage purchase orders, confirmations, and ETAs
* Follow up with vendors on availability, lead times, pricing, and backorders
* Catch discrepancies between POs, invoices, and received inventory

**Service issues**

* Track customer issues involving damages, missing parts, warranty claims, and replacements
* Coordinate with vendors, technicians, and customer support until each case is resolved
* Escalate high-risk issues before they become chargebacks or cancellations

**Warehouse & inventory**

* Coordinate daily with warehouse staff on receiving, shipping, staging, and order readiness
* Track which units are available, allocated, damaged, returned, or pending shipment
* Support inventory counts and report discrepancies

**Reporting**

* Keep order, shipment, purchasing, and service trackers current by end of day
* Send daily or weekly updates to the Director of Operations, whom you'll report to

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience in freight/logistics coordination, purchasing administration, or operations support
* Hands-on experience booking shipments or managing domestic and international purchase orders
* Comfortable in spreadsheets and at least one ERP, inventory, or order management system
* Able to work on-site full time in Hawthorne
* LTL freight experience

**Nice to have**

* Experience with large-item products such as fitness equipment, furniture, or appliances
* Experience handling warranty or damage claims
* Familiarity with Shopify, Xero, or Salesforce
