new_jobs.title: Textile Designer & Custom Rug Production Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About Mehraban**

Mehraban is a third-generation Los Angeles rug company specializing in luxury handmade rugs for leading interior designers, architects, hospitality projects, and private residences.

Since 1945, we have combined generations of rug knowledge and craftsmanship with a contemporary approach to design. Our collections include one-of-a-kind, contemporary, antique, and fully custom rugs produced by skilled weaving partners around the world.

We are looking for a talented, highly organized **Textile Designer & Custom Rug Production Coordinator** to join our Los Angeles team.

**The Role**

This is a hybrid **creative, technical, and production-focused position**.

The ideal candidate has a strong eye for design, color, pattern, fashion, and interiors, while also being extremely detail-oriented and comfortable managing the technical and organizational side of custom rug production.

You will work closely with our sales and design teams, clients, interior designers, and international weaving mills to develop custom rugs from initial concept through production.

You will also contribute to Mehraban's creative development by researching emerging trends, colors, materials, fashion, art, and interiors and helping develop new rug concepts and collections.

**Custom Rug Design & Artwork**

* Create professional tear sheets and presentations for custom rug projects.
* Resize, rescale, repeat, crop, and adapt existing artwork to different rug dimensions and shapes.
* Engineer pattern repeats while maintaining the integrity and proportion of the original design.
* Develop custom colorways and recolor existing designs.
* Create rug renderings using Galaincha or similar textile/rug visualization software.
* Prepare Illustrator templates showing artwork, dimensions, colors, materials, and client/project information.
* Occasionally develop original rug designs and concepts for custom projects and Mehraban collections.
* Assist our sales team, clients, and interior designers with custom rug development.

**Creative Research & Product Development**

An important part of this position is bringing a strong creative point of view to the company.

* Research trends across **fashion, interiors, art, architecture, textiles, color, and materials**.
* Identify emerging colors, patterns, textures, and design directions relevant to the luxury interiors market.
* Develop mood boards, color stories, pattern ideas, and new rug concepts.
* Explore archival designs and reinterpret them through new colors, scales, constructions, and materials.
* Collaborate with the Mehraban team on new collections and product development.
* Help maintain a fresh and sophisticated visual direction while respecting Mehraban's design identity.

**Rug Production & Mill Coordination**

* Translate approved artwork into accurate, mill-ready production documents.
* Prepare order documents for custom, stock, and sample rugs.
* Specify dimensions, design scale, colors, fibers, construction, pile height, and other production details.
* Initiate orders with our weaving mills and communicate specifications clearly.
* Maintain regular email correspondence with mills regarding new orders, samples, revisions, production status, and technical questions.
* Follow up on active production and help resolve design or specification issues.
* Maintain accurate internal order records, digital files, and production archives.
* Follow established naming, filing, and ordering procedures.

**Quality Control**

* Review incoming samples, strike-offs, and finished rugs.
* Compare finished pieces against approved artwork, colors, dimensions, and construction specifications.
* Identify discrepancies in color, scale, material, construction, or workmanship.
* Develop an increasingly sophisticated understanding of fibers, weaving techniques, rug construction, pile, texture, and finishing.

**Sample Library & Organization**

Maintaining our physical and digital design resources is an important responsibility of this position.

* Maintain and organize the showroom's rug and textile sample library.
* Properly label, catalog, archive, and track samples and strike-offs.
* Keep samples accessible and organized for the sales and design teams.
* Maintain corresponding digital artwork, specifications, and production records.
* Periodically review and reorganize samples as collections and vendors evolve.

**Additional Creative Support**

As needed, assist with:

* Catalogs and collection presentations.
* Sales presentations and PDF materials.
* Graphic and print materials.
* Website product assets and coordination.
* Coordination of imagery and assets for marketing, social media, SEO/AEO, and other digital initiatives.
* Communication with the warehouse and receiving team regarding incoming rugs and product information.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in **Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop**.
* Strong understanding of vector and raster artwork, pattern repeats, file formats, image resolution, pixel dimensions, and production-ready artwork.
* Excellent eye for **color, scale, proportion, pattern, texture, and composition**.
* Ability to distinguish subtle differences in color, including warm and cool undertones.
* Strong fashion and design sensibility with an awareness of contemporary interiors, art, textiles, and luxury design.
* Extremely detail-oriented and organized.
* Comfortable managing multiple projects and production deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong written communication skills and professional email correspondence.
* Ability to maintain organized physical and digital filing systems.
* Willingness and enthusiasm to learn about handmade rugs, fibers, weaving techniques, and construction.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in one or more of the following is highly desirable:

* Textile design
* Surface or pattern design
* Rug or carpet design
* Fashion textiles
* Interior design
* Luxury home furnishings
* Textile manufacturi

new_jobs.description:
#### **The Company**

Everflow is a SaaS Partner Marketing platform for managing and scaling revenue from affiliates, partnerships, and marketing channels.

Founded in 2016 by industry veterans, we have a team distributed across the NAM and EMEA regions.

We’re a bootstrapped and profitable company (over $29M ARR) that has grown through supporting happy customers that refer business to us and create word-of-mouth excitement. We’re the go-to platform for brands, agencies, and networks, with 1,100+ customers including top brands, agencies and networks*.*

Our Customer Success Manager, OM will possess the ability to meet or exceed all launch KPI’s; including but not limited to continuously minimizing time to first value, prescriptive guidance on the Everflow tools that support and grow our users’ businesses, and guide a smooth technical launch in collaboration with our Technical Solutions team.

Customer Success OMs will act and make decisions with a revenue expansion mindset (NRR); opportunity mapping, opportunity closing and relationship building continuously over their time spent with Everflow clients

* Ability to be a front-line Customer Success Manager from a relationship perspective. Build and maintain strong, multi threaded and long-lasting client relationships.
* Identify growth opportunities with customers, and develop and implement solutions to achieve revenue expansion goals.
* Develop expertise with new products and features and be able to evangelize them with clients.
* Understand the customer’s business goals and challenges in order to advocate for customer needs and to share feedback within the company to influence product development and service improvements.
* Monitor customer usage data and health metrics - Proactively identify any potential issues before they become problems and address accordingly.

#### **Qualifications**

* Ability to understand and explain technical concepts, as well as troubleshoot basic technical issues
* Ability to build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with clients, understanding their business goals, and acting as their trusted advisor
* Experience in sales or a strong understanding of sales principles, including the ability to negotiate contracts and upsell products or services
* A customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering exceptional service and exceeding client expectations
* Strong problem-solving skills to address client issues, resolve conflicts, and find creative solutions to meet client needs - Consultative in approach

#### **Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree
* 2-4 years experience in a similar role
* CRM tools like Hubspot/Jira (Basic)
* Experience using either Everflow or competitor tracking platforms (preferred but not required)
* Third Party analytics solutions - Google Analytics, Social/MediaBuying or MMPs (preferred but not required)

#### **Compensation Package:**

**Base Salary: $60,000 - $70,000**  
**Bonus Potential**

##### **Perks include:**

* Employer Covered Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Unlimited PTO and paid holidays
* 401(k) (No matching at this time)
* Paid parental leave for putting your family first
* Startup-like environment, without the constant rush to raise the next round of funding
* A very collaborative team and culture
* Education, gym, and equipment stipend

#### **Join Our Exceptional Team**

Dive into a role where respect, ownership, and mindfulness define our culture. As a valued team member, you'll enjoy the freedom to innovate and excel, supported by the tools and equipment you need to succeed.

**Work/Life Harmony:** Embrace unlimited PTO and a healthy balance that respects your life outside work.

**Inclusive Community:** Be part of a welcoming, engaging workplace that celebrates diversity and fun.

new_jobs.description:
**Description**

The Assistant Community (Property) Manager assists the Community Manager in the successful site management of the apartment community providing the necessary leadership, guidance and motivation to ensure a positive working environment and quality community living. The Assistant Community Manager is responsible for administering the day-to-day leasing office operations and is responsible for overseeing all computer input of the apartment community. The Assistant Community Manager directs the leasing staff, and works with the Community Manager to recommend marketing and leasing strategies designed to meet the goals of Shea Properties. The pay range for this position is $27.00 - $29.00/hour and the Assistant Community Manager is also eligible to participate in the office Sales Bonus, Club Shea Program and the discretionary annual bonus plan. JF Shea offers a competitive benefits package including PTO, paid holidays, medical, dental, vision, 401K, disability, life insurance, 35% discounted apartment (based on availability), and cell phone allowance.

**Job Duties**

* Leads and participates in lineup each morning.
* Ensures craigslist ads are posted daily.
* In conjunction with the Community Manager, supervises the input of all data into designated property management software and processing of related reports.
* Reviews and approves move out statements (SODA), ensuring all statements are completed timely in accordance with state law and that all charges are necessary and accurate as outlined in Shea Properties policies.
* Reviews and approves resident rental applications for move-ins in a fair and consistent manner in accordance with Fair Housing requirements and Shea Business Properties' policies and procedures.
* Assists in negotiation of rent increases and lease renewals with residents and supports the Community Manager in the execution of all necessary documents to implement all approved rental increases.
* In conjunction with the Community Manager, coordinates with Leasing and Maintenance staff a calendar of scheduled move-ins, ensuring all move-in appointments are completed and all apartments are inspected prior to move-in.
* In conjunction with Community Manager reviews Yieldstar each morning and submits pricing recommendations.
* Maintains all residents and vendor files, ensuring completeness and accuracy of all paperwork and documentation.
* Under the direction of the Community Manager, ensures the preparation and delivery of all legal and formal notices, including Three Day or 30 Covenant to Quit, Rent Increase Notices, Late Charge Notices, and Notices of Violation of Community Rules and Regulations, in accordance to California Civil Code and Shea Properties policy and procedure.
* Ensures the maintenance of all account records and transactions including NSF's, Rent Allowances, Concessions, Rent Increases, Utility Billing Collection, and other management approved debits/credits.
* Prepares beginning of the week (Monday Morning) reports in an accurate and timely manner.
* In conjunction with the Community Manager, directs the functions of the leasing office, supervise the leasing staff’s daily activities and the preparation of all leasing paperwork and documents related to residency. Ensures schedule of leasing staff to ensure proper staff levels in anticipation of traffic demands and workload.
* Acts as gate keeper for Avid Exchange
* Prepares work orders and submits for approval in Go Cart.
* Assists in the development, preparation and administration of the capital and operating budgets for the property.
* Participates in staff selection process. Recruits, hires, and trains all leasing staff under the approval and direction of the Community Manager.
* Prepares annual reviews for all direct reports, sets Incentive-Based Compensation Bonus Plan (IBC) goals and objectives and implements Professional Development Plans (PDP) for all associates.
* Supports and motivates staff to participate in company sponsored classes and provided training, with the objective of completing PDP and individual goals. Ensures compliance with all mandatory training.
* Oversee and/or conduct weekly sales “leasing fundamentals” meetings, sign and submit fundamentals to Regional Manager for review.
* Supports industry networking and encourages direct reports to participate in industry association functions.
* Performs other duties as assigned. Actual job duties and responsibilities may vary depending on the size of the community.
* Handle on-call duties, as directed by supervisor.

**Technical/Professional Knowledge (*****Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience*****)**

* Effective oral and written communication skills; ability to give clear direction and respond to inquiries.Must be able to speak effectively before groups of customers or associates of the organization.
* Understanding of accounting principles and budget process. Ability to read and interpret numerical information. Basic understanding of the budgeting process.
* Basic understanding of marketing concepts; analyzing data; and report writing.
* Customer service experience required in at least one of the following industries: property management, hospitality, retail, and real estate.
* Negotiate and resolve conflicts.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (Word/Excel/Outlook) and Yardi & Yieldstar preferred.
* Prior experience in managing a staff (supervise, train, coach, develop, motivate, interview, hire, terminate) and lead by example.
* High School Diploma or equivalent. Some college level courses preferred.
* Minimum of 2 years property management experience with at least 1 year at the management level.

**Requirements:**

* Experience working in DTC & B2B sales and/or the catering/private events industry. (Preferred).
* The ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
* The ability to work as part of a team.
* Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
* Exceptional communication and customer service skills.

new_jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
The Sobhani Research Group (PI: Nasim Sobhani) is dedicated to improving the care of pregnant individual and their infants. The bulk of our studies are focused on diabetes in pregnancy and how to optimize the care of pregnant people living with diabetes. Our studies examine how to improve perinatal outcomes for pregnant individuals with type 1 and type 2 diabetes; leverage advanced diabetes technology in the pregnant population; diagnose and manage gestational diabetes; and better support the emotional and behavioral needs of pregnant individuals with diabetes.

The Clinical Research Coordinator will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.

Incumbent’s duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports, including ensuring complete and accurate data capture; attend regular meetings with the PI and/or other members of the study team; coordinate staff work schedules, assist with training of Assistant CRCs, and assist Clinical Research Supervisor and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; support the development and submission of publications, presentations, reports, and other study-related documents; and perform other duties as assigned.

The CRC will assist the Sobhani Research Group with multiple projects. The CRC will design and develop RedCap databases, enroll patients in research studies and complete chart reviews, data collection and data for later data analysis. The CRC will also perform and/or coordinate biospecimen collection with study participants, coordinate with research team staff, perform initial sample processing and stabilization, and ensure transfer of the specimens to partnering research labs as needed. The CRC will work on IRB/CHR applications and submit protocols, regulatory documents, modifications and updates to the CHR for various ongoing studies. The CRC will coordinate with our multidisciplinary team and collaborators across departments within UCSF as well as non-UCSF campuses. This includes outreach and communication with referring healthcare providers and patient support organizations.

A successful candidate will have a desire to work directly with patients; be passionate about supporting research studies that aim to improve our understanding of pregnancy complications; be dedicated to optimizing the care of individuals with medically complex pregnancies; be committed to the development of evidence-based practices. They will be an independent problem-solver with excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills. They will have a high level of professionalism, an exceptional attention to detail, and experience managing multiple projects and timelines simultaneously. This is a great opportunity for an individual who is interested in academic research, medicine, health care, or public health. A two-year commitment is preferred.

**DEPARTMENT INFO:**

The Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology and Reproductive Sciences (Ob, Gyn & RS) is a major academic Department in the School of Medicine, engaged in clinical, research and training activities at the Parnassus, Mount Zion, and Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital campuses, the new Betty Irene Moore Women’s Hospital at Mission Bay, as well as satellite locations throughout the Bay Area, with an annual operating budget of $150 million. The Department has 134 full-time faculty, 117 other academic appointees, 13 post-doctoral fellows, 22 clinical fellows, 32 residents, 138 voluntary clinical faculty and 270 staff.

The mission of the Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences is to improve the lives and health of all women through excellence, innovation and leadership in patient care, scientific discovery, education, advocacy, and diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to providing quality health care services; educating health care providers and investigators; and conducting research to advance knowledge in our field.

Reasonable accommodation(s) to qualified individuals with disabilities are available as part of the application and interview processes. If you would like to request accommodations, please contact the recruiter or hiring manager. If workplace accommodations are needed after a job offer is made, please contact the supervisor and/or Disability Management Services (DMS) at (415) 476-2621 to initiate the interactive process.

  

REQUIRED:

* HS graduation and sufficient experience and demonstrated skills to successfully perform the assigned duties and responsibilities; and/or equivalent experience/training
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal

**Customer Success Lead**

Hybrid (San Francisco, CA) Full-time

**About Alethios**

Alethios is a decentralized health research platform. We give researchers one place to build a protocol, manage participants, and integrate wearables and surveys, in real-time, so they can go from formulation to validation without the friction of traditional, site-based research. We're a mission-driven company, focused on lowering the barriers to human health research for both researchers and participants. And we're growing quickly: more studies, more researchers, more categories, every month.

We're looking for someone who cares about human health, sweats the details, builds things, and wants to be at a mission-driven company. This is the first hire in this function. You'll define what customer success means at Alethios, reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with Business Operations and Engineering.

**The role**

You'll own customer success end to end: study startup, go-live, and study ops. Day-to-day, that means working directly with researchers and sponsors to get their studies launched and run well.

The bigger opportunity is what you build while doing it. We launch 5 to 10 studies a month and that number is growing fast. The tools you create, such as automated study-health monitoring, templated onboarding, or AI-assisted client reporting, are what will take it substantially higher without growing the team. The best people here make themselves more leveraged every month, and this role is designed for that.

The work comes down to four things: relationship management, tool building, excellent follow-through, and both an instinct and an analytic approach for what makes a great study.

**What you'll do**

* Run study kickoff and onboarding: offer input on protocol digitization and study decentralization
* Monitor study health: enrollment pacing, participant compliance, data flow from surveys and wearables
* Own the client communication cadence: status updates, mid-study check-ins, results walkthroughs. Build the systems that generate these updates
* Coordinate with our distribution team on kit timing, client product receipt, and participant mailing
* Drive renewals and expansion: a great first study should become a second
* Build the machine: automated study-health dashboards, templated onboarding flows, self-serve client resources, AI-assisted reporting
* Be the voice of the customer to engineering: feed pain points and patterns back into the product roadmap

**Who you are**

* You're product-minded: you've built workflows, automations, or internal tools, and you reach for AI tooling by default
* You're health-focused, with either a serious hunger to learn and analyze data or a clinical/research background
* You prepare for every meeting: clients notice, and so do we
* You're organized under pressure: multiple concurrent studies won't rattle you
* You're creative: when the obvious process doesn't fit, you invent one that does

**Nice to have**

* Clinical credentials or a health sciences background
* Experience at an early-stage company where you built the function rather than inherited it
* Familiarity with HubSpot, Intercom, or IRB submission tools

**Benefits**

We want our team to feel supported, in work and in life. Alethios offers:

* **Competitive compensation** including equity that reflects the value and impact you bring from day one
* **Health benefits**: we cover 100% of healthcare and dental plan premiums for employees
* **Generous PTO** so you can recharge fully and show up at your best
* **Mission-driven work** that directly lowers barriers to evidence generation and makes research more accessible
* **A dynamic team**: small and collaborative, where every voice matters and cross-disciplinary thinking shapes the product daily
* **SF office with flexibility**: this role is hybrid out of our San Francisco office

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About City Winery**

Imagine a sold-out show, a glass of wine made on-site, and a great dinner, all under one roof. That's City Winery. Every year we produce thousands of concerts and hundreds of wines across ten live entertainment venues in nine metropolitan areas. Each venue is also a working winery and restaurant. We also run five standalone restaurants and winegardens.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Digital Marketing Coordinator to join our digital marketing team and help fill the room, night after night. Reporting to our Digital Marketing Manager, you'll build, launch, and optimize paid social and programmatic campaigns that turn a scroll into a ticket sale, and you'll see the results of your work in real time as shows sell out.

This is an entry-level role built for learning. From day one you'll manage live campaigns on the major ad platforms, work with real budgets, and learn performance marketing fundamentals from an experienced team. Because the team is small, your ideas and your work will be seen and will make a real difference. If you love digital marketing and want to start your career in live music, food, and wine, we'd love to meet you.  
  
 **What You'll Do**

* Build and launch digital ad campaigns for shows at City Winery venues on platforms including Meta, Google, TikTok, StackAdapt, Vibe, and LinkedIn.
* Monitor and optimize ad spend, CPA, and ROAS so every dollar works as hard as possible.
* Write and refresh ad copy that matches the City Winery brand voice, priority keywords, and website messaging.
* Test new ideas across creative, audiences, and targeting, measure what works, and share what you learn with the team.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports and turn the numbers into clear takeaways.
* Work with local marketing teams at each venue so campaigns support their show calendars and overall strategy.
* Help track progress against annual paid media goals.
* Implement AI Search and SEO tactics that improve search performance, including maintaining search listings and updating website content.
* Support other digital marketing priorities such as email, and SMS as needed.
* Keep up with digital advertising trends and bring new ideas to the table.

  
**What You'll Learn**  

* How to plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across multiple paid social and programmatic platforms
* How to read performance data and connect ad spend to ticket sales
* How live events are marketed, from announcement to on-sale to sold out
* How AI tools can speed up campaign creation, testing, and reporting
* How a small, fast-moving digital team works across ecommerce, venues, and brand

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree required; a degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or a related field is preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the curiosity to ask questions when something isn't clear
* A basic understanding of digital marketing concepts. Coursework, internships, and personal projects all count.
* Comfort with Google Workspace, especially spreadsheets
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines on your own
* A tech-savvy mindset and interest in how AI tools can make marketing smarter and faster
* A genuine passion for music, food, wine, and live entertainment
* Based in New York City, with potential, occasional travel to other City Winery locations

**Bonus Points**

* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, StackAdapt, Vibe, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4) or other analytics tools
* Experience managing local listings

**About Us**

Wine, food, and live entertainment collide at City Winery to create a dynamic and incredibly unique workplace. Since 2008, City Winery has been turning heads across the nation with amazing live performances, delectable cuisine, and award winning, locally produced wines. But there's more to us than that we're a haven for community and creativity, a place where the philosophy of hospitality is more than just a buzzword, but a way of life. City Winery, founded by music industry veteran & visionary Michael Dorf, has established itself as a one-of-a-kind brand providing unforgettable experiences for guests. From world class music venues to sustainably produced wines with ratings of 90+ points, City Winery offers a range of topnotch events & experiences.

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at City Winery. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Additionally, City Winery participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.**

new_jobs.title: Brand Marketing Lead-JPMorgan Payments
new_jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Help shape how J.P. Morgan Payments shows up in market - and why customers should care. In this role, you'll turn business and product priorities into a clear narrative and creative strategy that builds authority over time.

As a Vice President, Brand Strategy in J.P. Morgan Payments, you will define the narrative and creative strategy behind our biggest market investments. You'll bring the customer point of view into a complex, global organization and use audience insight to sharpen what we say and make. You'll partner closely with stakeholders, agencies, and our creative studio to ensure the work is coherent across touchpoints and compounds over time.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Translate business, product, and go-to-market priorities into a clear market narrative and creative strategy.
* Define an audience-centered point of view that builds brand authority and cultural capital over time.
* Steward how the brand shows up across flagship programs and key touchpoints.
* Own audience testing end-to-end, including participants, questions, and stimulus.
* Balance learning (what resonates) with validation (what we must prove to build alignment and confidence).
* Partner with agencies to distill findings into clear, actionable recommendations that elevate the work.
* Partner with the creative studio to define what the work must accomplish and what “good” looks like.
* Use audience insight to guide decisions—sharpening metaphors, focusing copy, and raising creative craft.
* Define clear assignments and translate competing stakeholder input into usable direction for agency partners.
* Lead agency partners to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.
* Leverage marketing science to raise the standard for how a matrixed organization shows up in market.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:**

* Apply marketing science to build strategies and drive focus (including category entry points, the 95:5 rule, and System 1/System 2 thinking).
* Build an audience-centered point of view that earns authority through the work, not just claims.
* Distill ambiguity and competing inputs into a clear path forward.
* Influence stakeholders without formal authority, knowing when to hold the line and when to compromise.
* Bring deep audience obsession, pressure-testing decisions against what matters to customers.
* Translate complexity into a coherent narrative that connects across touchpoints and compounds over time.
* Operate fluidly across strategy and execution—moving from insight to assignment to strong delivery.
* Rally teams around a shared vision and change minds, including in resistant rooms.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:**

* Bring experience building brand and narrative strategy inside a highly matrixed, global organization.
* Demonstrate strong partnership with creative teams, with comfort shaping work through craft (not personal taste).
* Show confidence leading external agencies through complex feedback and multiple stakeholders.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About IconicCare**

IconicCare places an in-house physiatrist in skilled nursing facilities at no cost to the facility. Our providers

are in the building 2–3 days a week, focused on pain management, function, and skin integrity. That means

patients hit their discharge function goals, opioid use comes down, and falls and hospital readmissions drop.

We were founded by physiatrist Dr. Christian Morris, and we're growing quickly into new markets.

**The role**

You'll own the greater Atlanta metro. You'll visit skilled nursing facilities across the metro, build relationships with

Administrators and Directors of Nursing, and set up alignment calls with Dr. Morris and our Director of

Revenue Operations. You don't need a clinical background, because Dr. Morris handles the clinical

conversation on the call. Your job is building trust in the building and getting the right people on the

calendar.

Because this is a home territory, you'll be back in the same buildings regularly. Those who do best here

turn a front-desk hello into a first-name relationship with the DON.

If you're picturing struggling to get past the front desk and getting shown the door, this is the opposite. Facilities need

what we have. In-house physiatry is in high demand and hard to find, and most buildings have been trying to

get this kind of coverage for a long time. When you walk in, you're not selling something. You're a partner to our

clinical team, helping facilities get the care their patients need.

When it's done right, staff don't see you as a marketer. They see you as part of the clinical care team, someone

who understands their challenges and connects them with Dr. Morris for the full clinical picture. Doors open

easily, and getting in front of the Administrator and Director of Nursing in person is usually the easy part.

**Who we want (and who we don't)**

We want people who learn quickly and are incredibly friendly/personable. We'll teach you the industry.

We are intentionally not looking for marketing reps from wound care, therapy, hospice, or other SNF vendor

companies. We want a different kind of presence in these buildings, not the one administrators already hear from

every week. You need to be good at following a system, keeping notes, and making friends.

**What you'll do**

new_jobs.title: Drayage Account Manager - Chicago
new_jobs.description:
This Is Not a Maintenance Role

Amnex Solutions is looking for a high-output Drayage Account Manager who can take ownership of demanding customer accounts, move freight under pressure, protect profitability, and create growth.

We are not looking for someone who simply forwards emails, updates spreadsheets, or waits for instructions. We need someone who anticipates problems, makes decisions, drives communication, and treats every account like a business within the business.

If a container is approaching last free day, you are already working on the solution. If a carrier falls off, you immediately coordinate recovery. If a customer has additional freight, you recognize the opportunity and pursue it. You do not wait for problems—or revenue—to find you.

**About Amnex Solutions**

Amnex Solutions Corp is one of the fastest-growing 4PLs in the country, specializing in drayage, intermodal, and OTR transportation throughout the United States.

Founded in January 1, 2024 by transportation professionals with more than 16 years of industry experience, Amnex has grown at an extraordinary pace by solving problems others cannot, responding faster than the competition, and holding its team to an uncompromising standard of execution.

We are building a dominant national logistics organization—not a comfortable, slow-moving brokerage. The people who join us now will have the opportunity to help shape the company, build major customer accounts, and grow into leadership positions as we continue expanding.

**The Mission**

As a Drayage Account Manager, you will take command of assigned customer accounts from order acceptance through final delivery, empty return, documentation, and billing.

Your mission is straightforward:

Keep containers moving.  

Keep customers informed.  
Eliminate preventable accessorials.  
Protect and improve margins.  
Solve problems before they escalate.  
Expand the accounts under your control.  

You will have support from carrier sales, tracking, accounting, and company leadership—but ownership of the account belongs to you.

**What You Will Own**

**Customer Accounts**

Serve as the primary point of contact and operational authority for assigned customers.  

Learn each customer’s business, facilities, SOPs, priorities, and service expectations.  
Provide fast, accurate, and proactive communication without making customers chase you for updates.  
Build enough trust that customers bring additional lanes, locations, and projects directly to you.  
Identify weaknesses in the customer’s transportation network and present Amnex solutions.  
Turn excellent execution into measurable account growth.  

**Drayage Execution**

Manage import and export container shipments through ports, rail terminals, warehouses, distribution centers, and customer facilities.  

Confirm releases, availability, last free days, appointments, equipment requirements, customs status, delivery requirements, and empty-return instructions.  
Track every shipment through pickup, delivery, empty return, documentation, and financial closeout.  
Monitor demurrage, detention, per diem, storage, chassis usage, and other accessorial exposure.  
Prevent avoidable charges through aggressive follow-up, planning, and escalation.  
Build recovery plans when appointments fail, terminals close, containers are unavailable, carriers fall off, or customer requirements change.  
Maintain accurate and complete shipment information in Turvo.  

**Profitability and Growth**

Understand the revenue, cost, margin, and risk associated with every shipment.  

Protect margins while maintaining the service required to retain and grow the account.  
Challenge unnecessary costs and identify operational inefficiencies.  
Work with carrier sales to develop dedicated capacity and stronger pricing.  
Recognize expansion opportunities and actively pursue additional customer volume.  
Treat assigned accounts as businesses that must become larger, stronger, and more profitable over time.  

**Carrier Coordination**

Partner with the carrier sales team to secure reliable capacity at competitive rates.  

Build productive relationships with high-performing drayage carriers and dispatch teams.  
Confirm rates, appointments, equipment, driver information, terminal access, and service requirements before dispatch.  
Ensure carriers meet Amnex insurance, safety, compliance, and onboarding standards.  
Hold carriers accountable for communication, documentation, and service performance.  
Help develop dedicated capacity for recurring lanes and major projects.  

**Documentation and Financial Closeout**

Collect PODs, interchange receipts, gate tickets, scale tickets, lumper receipts, invoices, and other required documents.  

Confirm that accessorial charges are valid, documented, and communicated promptly.  
Maintain complete shipment records so accounting can bill customers and pay carriers accurately.  
Resolve missing documentation, rate discrepancies, and outstanding charges before they delay closeout.  

**The Standard**

At Amnex, strong performance means more than keeping up with email.

A successful Drayage Account Manager:

Knows the status and next action for every active shipment.  

Communicates problems before the customer discovers them.  
Moves quickly without sacrificing accuracy.  
Takes ownership instead of passing responsibility.  
Follows through until every issue is completely resolved.  
Maintains control when operations become chaotic.  
Protects the company’s reputation and profitability.  
Consistently expands the value of assigned accounts.  
Raises the performance of the people around them.  

**Required Qualifications**

At least two years of meaningful experience in drayage, intermodal, container logistics, freight brokerage, or a comparable transportation environment.

The ideal candidate is organized, collaborative, attentive to detail, and committed to LCC’s mission, with a willingness to share their Christian faith and compassion with those served.

**Position Summary**

HMC Operations and Production Coordinator manages the day-to-day operations of the Hearts of Mercy & Compassion (HMC) Ministry, with a focus on inventory, assembly, order fulfillment, shipping, vendor coordination, volunteers, and related logistics. This role ensures that hearts, fish, crosses, and supplies are ready and delivered on time to support ministry requests, church affiliates, and crisis response.

The person in this position must be committed to LCC’s mission and comfortable sharing their Christian faith to encourage and support those served.

**General Responsibilities**

**Inventory and Vendor Coordination**

* Maintain adequate inventory of hearts, fish, panels, crosses, hardware, paint, decals, packing materials, and other ministry supplies.
* Coordinate with vendors and ministry partners to order products and supplies, monitor delivery timelines, and address quality or availability concerns.
* Identify reliable vendors locally and nationally to support LCC and HMC church affiliates with HMC Director’s approval.
* Organize supplies and finished products so they are accessible and ready for assembly, fulfillment, and deployment.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and anticipate replenishment needs.

**Assembly, Fulfillment, and Shipping**

* Coordinate and participate in the building, painting, customization, and preparation of hearts and crosses using established ministry procedures.
* Schedule work to meet ministry requests and order deadlines.
* Confirm personalization details with requestors and ensure completed items are accurate and meet ministry quality standards.
* Maintain the HMC Parts Order System, including available products and pricing.
* Process affiliate orders, prepare packages, arrange shipping or delivery, and track fulfillment.
* Coordinate Cricut files, supplies, and use for ministry customization.

**Volunteer Coordination**

* Recruit and schedule daily volunteers for special projects when necessary, and support volunteers assisting with building, machining, painting, customization, packing, and related projects.
* Match volunteer assignments to individual abilities and provide clear instructions, materials, and support.
* Coordinate with HMC affiliate teams, who prepare ministry items off-site, ensuring they have the necessary supplies and understand expectations.
* Review completed work for consistency and quality.
* Record volunteer participation in designated software.

**Affiliate Support and Training**

* Serve as a resource for church affiliates regarding supplies, ordering, assembly, customization, and ministry procedures.
* Assist in new affiliate training with HMC Director using established materials and hands-on instruction.
* Keep assembly instructions, painting guides, personalization resources, the Affiliate Manual, and training materials current.
* Assist with creating videos for online affiliate training.
* Support the growth of HMC church affiliates and volunteer and vendor partnerships nationally.

**Ministry Logistics and Crisis Response**

* Partner with other LCC ministries on joint deployments and visits.
* Participate in deployments as needed.
* May be asked to represent LCC and HMC at conferences, events, and presentations.

**Records and Operational Support**
